description.en: Unleashes his demonic form for 10 seconds, gaining 30% / 40% / 50% Attack Damage, 25% / 35% / 45% increased healing and 60% / 75% / 90% decaying Movement Speed. World Ender's duration is extended by 5 seconds with a takedown, up to 10 extra seconds. Nearby minions and monsters are feared for 3 seconds on activation.

Swings his giant blade, dealing 10 / 40 / 70 / 100 (+75% / 80% / 85% / 90% AD) physical damage. This ability can be cast 2 more times, with each cast dealing 25% more damage. Enemies hit on the sweetspot will be knocked airborne for 0.25 seconds and dealt 60% bonus damage. Deals 65% damage to minions. Deals 70% damage to monsters.

Sends a chain dealing 25 / 40 / 55 / 70 (+40% AD) physical damage to the first enemy hit and slowing them by 25% for 1.5 seconds. If a champion or large monster remains within the imapct area after 1.5 seconds, they will be dragged back to the center and take the same damage again. Deals double damage to minions.

Passive: Aatrox gains 19% / 21% / 23% / 25% physical vamp against enemy champions, increased to 24% / 31% / 38% / 45% during World Ender. Active: Dashes forward. This resets Aatrox's normal attack. Usable whie casting other abilities.

Enhances his next attack every 24 seconds to deal bonus 4% - 13% physical damage of the target's maximum Health and heals himself for the same amount. Deathbringer Stance's cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds when Aatrox hits a Champion or large monster with an attack or ability. Max 50 damage against monsters. Healing reduced to 60% against minions.

Ahri dashes forward and fires essence bolts, dealing 60 / 90 / 120 (+35% AP) magic damage to 3 nearby enemies. This ability can be recast up to 2 more times within 12 seconds. During Spirit Rush, if Ahri devours a champion's essence with Essence Theft, Ahri will extend Spirit Rush's recast duration up to 10 seconds, and she gains an extra charge of Spirit Rush (Can store up to 3 charges). Dash range increases while leveling up. Essence bolts attack champions first.
Launches an orb that deals 40 / 75 / 110 / 145 (+45% AP) magic damage on the way out and 40 / 75 / 110 / 145 (+45% AP) true damage on the way back.

Releases 3 fox-fires that seek nearby enemies and deal 45 / 80 / 115 / 150 (+35% AP) magic damage. Ahri gains 45% Movement Speed that decays over 1.5 seconds. Enemies hit by multiple fox-fires take 30% damage for each fox-fire beyond the first. Fox-fires prioritize champions hit by Charm, followed by recently attacked enemies.
Ahri blows a kiss dealing 60 / 100 / 140 / 180 (+50% AP) magic damage and charming the first enemy hit, causing them to walk towards Ahri for 1.4 / 1.6 / 1.8 / 2 seconds.

Grants a stack of Essence Theft if her ability hits a target. At 3 stacks, Ahri's next ability that hits an enemy heals her for 40 (+20% AP). If an enemy champion that Ahri has damaged within 3 seconds dies, she will consume their essence to heal herself for 80 (+35% AP).

First Cast: Dashes through an enemy champion, dealing 80 / 200 / 320 (+50% bonus AD +30% AP) magic damage. Can be cast again after 2.5 seconds. Recast: Dashes in target direction, dealing 70 to 210 (+30% AP to +90% AP)  magic damage based upon enemies' missing Health. Deals max damage to enemies below 35% health.
Throws five kunais, dealing 35 / 70 / 105 / 140 (+65% AD +60% AP) magic damage. Enemies struck at maximum range are slowed by 50% for 0.5 seconds.

Creates a smoke cloud that expands over 5.5 / 6 / 6.5 / 7 seconds and grants 100 maximum energy. Akali is invisible and gains 35% / 40% / 45% / 50% Movement Speed inside the shroud. Attacking breaks the invisibility for 0.67 seconds.

First Cast: Flips backwards as she throws a shuriken, dealing 30 / 60 / 90 / 120 (+25% AD +30% AP) magic damage and marking the first enemy hit for 3 seconds. If no enemy is hit, the shuriken hits and marks Twilight Shroud's smoke cloud instead. Recast: dashes to the target, dealing 70 / 120 / 170 / 220 (+50% AD +80% AP) magic damage.

Dealing active ability damage to a champion reveals a ring for 4 seconds. Crossing the ring empowers Akali's next attack to deal 25 + 12 per level (+60% bonus AD +65% AP) bonus magic damage. Gains 30% Movement Speed while moving toward the ring. Upon crossing the ring, she gains 30% Movement Speed while moving toward enemy champions for 2 seconds.

Locks onto an enemy champion, charging 5 /  6 / 7 shots over 3 seconds. Re-cast: Fires the shots, dealing 25 / 35 / 45 (+15% AD) physical damage to the first enemy or structure hit, increased up to 75 / 105 / 135 (+45% AD) physical damage based on the target's missing health. Each shot's damage is further increased by a percentage equal to 30% of Critical Rate. Shots execute minions.

Throws a boomerang that deals 60 / 110 / 160 / 210 (+70% bonus AD) physical damage, extending the range each time it hits an enemy. Hits grant Akshan 40% Movement Speed decaying over 1 second. Deals 50% / 60% / 70% / 80% damage to minions.

Passive: Enemies that kill allied champions become Scoundrels for 40 seconds. When a Scoundrel dies within 3 seconds of being damaged by Akshan, Akshan gains 100 gold and revives the slain allies. Active: Become camouflaged for 1.75 seconds, gaining 80% / 90% / 100% / 110% Movement Speed and Mana Regeneration equal to 2% of missing mana when moving toward Scoundres. Duration is infinite while Akshan is near terrain or in bush.

Fires a hook to attach and swing around terrain, attacking the nearest enemy dealing 30 / 70 / 110 / 150 (+15% AD) physical damage. If Akshan collides with an enemy champion or terrain, he will jump off the rope. Re-cast: Jumps off the rope. Champion takedowns refresh this ability's cooldown. Prioritizing champions recently damaged by Akshan. On-hit effects deal 25% damage. Each shot can Critically Strike for 70% of current Critical Damage.

Every three hits from attacks and abilities deal bonus 25 magic damage. Against champions, also gain a shield that absorbs 40 (+40% bonus AD) damage for 2 seconds (12 second cooldown). After launching an attack, Akshan will fire a second shot that deals 26 (50% AD) physical damage. The shot can be cancelled to gain bonus 20 - 80 (based on level) (+100% bonus Attack Speed) Movement Speed decaying over 1 second.
Removes crowd control effects and gains 55% damage reduction for 7 seconds.
Deals 60 (+50% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies and knocks them up for 1 second.

Dashes toward an enemy, dealing 50 (+60% AP) magic damage and knocking them back.
May target turrets to deal 75% damage.

Tramples the ground, dealing 10 magic damage to nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds for 5 seconds, up to a max of 100 (+40% AP) magic damage.
If Trample damages an enemy champion 5 times, Alistar's next attack against champions within 5 seconds is empowered to deal an additional 40 (based on level) magic damage and stun for 1 second.
Only one stack can be gained per tick.

When Alistar takes damage, he heals himself for 27 (based on level) and nearby allied champions for 54 (based on level).
Knocking up or stunning champions with his abilities reduces the cooldown by 10 seconds.

Passive: Gains 10% Armor Penetration. Her active abilities heal her for 12.5% of the damage dealt.
Damaging minions heals her for 25% of the original heal, and damaging monsters heals her for 40% of the original heal.
The empowered attacks of Drakehound's Step grant the same healing bonus.
Active: Seizes the farthest enemy champion in a line and blinks to them, suppressing the target for 1 second. During this time, she gains 10% damage reduction and is Unstoppable. She then slams the target into the ground, dealing physical damage equal to 200 plus 10% of their missing Health (10% +0.05% bonus AD +0.05% AP) and stunning them for 0.4 seconds.
If Public Execution does not hit an enemy champion, 35% of its cooldown is refunded.

Cunning Sweep: Swings her Twin Drakehounds around herself, dealing 30 (+30% bonus AD) physical damage + 2% (+0.02% bonus AD) of the target's max Health. Against enemies at the edge of the strike, this damage is increased to 60 (+60% bonus AD) + 4% (+0.04% bonus AD) of the target's max Health.
If Cunning Sweep hits an enemy, after a brief delay, it transforms into Sundering Slam for 3.5 seconds.
Sundering Slam: Ruthlessly cleaves enemies in a line, dealing 70 (+90% bonus AD) physical damage + 4% (+0.04% bonus AD) of the target's max Health to the first enemy hit.
All other targets take 35 (+45% bonus AD) physical damage + 2% (+0.02% bonus AD) of their max Health.
The percent max Health damage against monsters is capped at 55 (based on level).

description.en:
Braces herself for a showdown, gaining a shield that absorbs 50 (based on level) (+120% bonus AD) damage for 1.5 seconds and blocking all crowd control effects for 0.5 seconds. She then unleashes a shockwave, dealing 70 (+80% bonus AD) physical damage to nearby enemies.
If she blocked an immobilizing effect, the shockwave's damage is increased to 105 (+120% bonus AD).

Swings her Twin Drakehounds around herself, dealing 40 (+50% bonus AD) physical damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 99%. The slow decays over 1 second.
Recast: If Drakehound's Step is triggered after casting Lacerate, Ambessa casts Lacerate again at the end of the dash.

Feint: Pushing the left joystick right after casting an ability causes Ambessa to dash a short distance in that direction.
Drakehound's Step: Her next attack within 4 seconds of triggering Feint gains 50% Attack Speed and increased range, deals 5 + 2.5 (based on level) (+25% bonus AD) bonus physical damage, and restores 50 Energy (based on level) (increases at levels 1/6/11). Stacks up to 3 times.
Deals 150 / 250 / 350 (+70% AP) magic damage to all nearby enemies and stuns them for 1.5 seconds. Applies Cursed Touch.

Passive: Bandage Toss charges are stored every 13 / 12.5 / 12 / 11.5 seconds, up to a maximum of 2 charges. Active: Launches a bandage that deals 60 / 95 / 130 / 165 (+70% AP) magic damage and stuns the target for 1 second, pulling himself to the target.
Toggle: Begins weeping to deal 25 / 30 / 35 / 40 magic damage + 1.2% / 1.5% / 1.8% / 2.1% (+0.4% AP) of their maximum Health to nearby enemies every second.

Passive: Amumu takes 1 / 3 / 5 / 7 (+4% bonus Armor +4% bonus MR) reduced physical damage. Active: Deals 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 (+50% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies and slows them by 10% for 0.5 seconds. Tantrum's cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds when Amumu is hit by an attack.
Attacks curse the target to take an additional 10% true damage from incoming magic damage for 3 seconds. Subsequent applications of Cursed Touch will refresh its duration.

Summon Tibbers, dealing 130 / 230 / 330 (+60% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies. For the next 20 seconds, Tibbers attack deals 70 / 100 / 130 (+20% AP) magic damage. Tibbers Enrages (granting him 100% Movement Speed and 210% Attack Speed): When summoned, after pouncing on an enemy, or when Annie dies. Recast: Orders Tibbers to pounce on the target. The pounce cannot be blocked. Upon landing, Tibbers deals 110 / 150 / 190 (+30% AP) magic damage and knocks the target Airborne.
Hurls a fireball that explodes in a small area, dealing 80 / 130 / 180 / 230 (+85% AP) magic damage. Killing an enemy refunds Disintegrate's Mana Cost and halves its Cooldown.
Releases a cone of fire that deals 70 / 130 / 190 / 250 (+70% AP) magic damage to all enemies within it.
Grants herself and Tibbers a shield that absorbs 50 / 100 / 150 / 200 (+40% AP) damage for 3 seconds and gains 25% / 30% / 35% / 40% Movement Speed that decays over 3 seconds.
After casting 4 abilities, the next offensive ability stuns enemies hit for 1 second.

Fires an arrow of ice that stuns the first enemy champion hit and deals 200 (+40% AP) magic damage to all nearby enemies. The stun lasts 1.5–3.5 seconds, increasing with the distance the arrow has traveled.
Recast: Hold and drag to steer the arrow's path. The arrow can only deviate from its original launch direction by a fixed angle. Tap the cancel button to stop steering.
Ashe can move while steering the arrow, but crowd control that interrupts channeling also automatically stops the steering.

Passive: Attacks grant a Focus stack for 4 seconds. At 4 stacks, this ability can be cast.
Active: Gains 20% Attack Speed for 6 seconds. While active, her attacks become a flurry of arrows, dealing 115% physical damage.

Fires 5 arrows in a cone, dealing 70 (+100% bonus AD) physical damage per arrow.
Enemies can intercept multiple arrows, but only take damage from the first.
Volley applies a critical slow to enemy champions hit, greatly reducing their Move Speed.

Fires a hawk spirit that reveals enemies along its path.
Recast: The hawk spirit disperses, granting vision of the area for 5 seconds. Units within the area are revealed for 5 seconds.

Attacks and damaging abilities slow enemies hit by 20% (based on level) for 2 seconds.
Attacks deal 0% bonus damage. This damage increases by 100% of her Critical Rate and Critical Damage.
Critical strikes deal no extra damage, instead slowing the target by 40% (based on level), decaying over time.

Falling Star: Plucks a star from the heavens and crashes it into the earth, dealing 150 (+65% AP) magic damage to enemies in the area and stunning them for 1 second. Gains 8 stacks of Stardust for each enemy champion hit.
Every time Aurelion Sol gains 65 stacks of Stardust, the next Falling Star transforms into The Skies Descend.
The Skies Descend: Rains down cosmic fury on the earth, dealing 188 (+82% AP) magic damage over a large area and knocking up targets hit for 1 second. It also emits a huge shockwave at the same time, dealing 150 (+65% AP) magic damage to enemy champions and epic monsters and slowing all enemies hit by 50% for 1 second.

Breathes starfire for 3.25 seconds, dealing 58 + 2.5 × level (+60% AP) magic damage per second to the first enemy hit and 50% of that damage to nearby enemies.
For every 1 second the breath hits the same enemy, deals a burst of magic damage equal to 70 + 0.5 × level (+35% AP) plus 0% (3% of Stardust stacks) of the target's max Health. If the target is a champion, Aurelion Sol gains 1 stack of Stardust.
Damage based on the target's max Health is capped at 100 against monsters.
Aurelion Sol can move slowly while casting this ability.
At max ability level, this ability's duration becomes infinite.
If the cast is interrupted within 0.25 seconds of casting this ability, it goes on a 1-second cooldown.
Deals 40% damage to monsters.

First Cast: Flies in the target direction. While flying, Breath of Light has no cooldown or max channel duration, and deals 15% more damage.
Recast: Ends the flight early.
If an enemy champion dies within 3 seconds of taking damage from Aurelion Sol, this ability's cooldown is reduced by 90%.
Flight speed: 300 (+100% Move Speed).
Flight speed is reduced by 50% if Breath of Light is cast while flying.

Summons a black hole, dealing 20 (+15% AP) magic damage per second for 5 seconds and dragging enemies toward its center.
Enemies in the center are executed instantly when their Health falls below 5% (5 + 2.1% of Stardust stacks) Health.
For every second an enemy champion is trapped within the black hole, Aurelion Sol gains 2 stacks of Stardust. When enemies die within the black hole, he gains 5 stacks of Stardust for each champion or epic monster, 5 stacks of Stardust for each siege minion or large monster, and 1 stack of Stardust for each minion or small monster.

Casting damaging abilities on enemies grants stacks of Stardust, empowering each of his abilities.
Breath of Light: Bursts deal bonus magic damage equal to 0% (3% of Stardust stacks) of the target's max Health.
Astral Flight: Increases max flight distance by 0% (62.5% of Stardust stacks).
Singularity: Increases the area of effect by 0% (40% of Stardust stacks) and the execution Health threshold by 0% (2.1% of Stardust stacks).
Falling Star / The Skies Descend: Increases the area of effect by 0% (40% of Stardust stacks).

First Cast: Leaps in a direction. Upon landing, converges the realms, sending out a pulse of spirit energy that deals 150 / 250 / 350 (+50% AP) magic damage and slows enemies hit by 30% for 2 seconds. The area of convergence stays active for 2.5 / 3.25 / 4 seconds, granting Aurora Realm Hopper and allowing her to jump from one edge of the area to another. Enemies attempting to enter or leave the area are slowed by 50% for 1.5 / 1.75 / 2 seconds. Recast: Ends the area of convergence effect early.

First Cast: Fires cursed energy ion a direction, dealing 40 / 70 / 100 / 130 (+33% AP) magic damage to enemies and cursing them for 3.5 seconds. Recast: Detonates the curse, dealing up to 40 / 70 / 100 / 130 (+33% AP) magic damage to enemies passed through. Enemies take up to 50% bonus damage based on missing Health. Damage beyond the first hit is reduced by 20%. Deals 40% damage against minions and monsters instead. If the curse's duration runs out, Aurora will automatically recast the ability.

Hops in a direction. Upon landing, enters the spirit realm, becoming invisible for 1 / 1.2 / 1.4 / 1.6 seconds and entering Realm Hopper. Realm Hopper: Gains 25% / 30% / 35% / 40% Movement Speed for 4 seconds. Scoring a takedown on an enemy champion resets this ability's cooldown.

Converges the realms, sending out a blast of spirit magic that deals 80 / 130 / 180 / 230 (+65% AP) magic damage to enemies in the area and slows them by 80%, decaying over 1 second. Aurora hops backward a short distance after casting.

Damaging an enemy 3 times with abilities or attacks exorcises them, dealing 2.5% (+2%AP) of the target's max Health as magic damage. If the enemy is a champion, it also frees a spirit that follows Aurora for 4 seconds, restoring her Health by 1 - 18 (+2% AP) every second ( max 4 spirits) .
Hurls magical protective energy at an area, placing all units and structures hit into stasis for 2.5 seconds. While in stasis, they are invulnerable, untargetable, and unable to act.

Fires an energy bolt, dealing 80 (+80% AP) magic damage to the first enemy hit and slowing it by 60% for 1.1 seconds.
The bolt then continues onward for a short distance. If it hits a second enemy or a wall, the enemies are stunned for 1.1 seconds. If it hits a second enemy, it also deals the same damage to them as to the first enemy.

Creates a Health shrine that gradually grows and powers up, reaching max effect after 5 seconds. The first ally to touch it gains 22.5% (+0.05% AP) Move Speed (for 1.5 seconds) and restores at least 50 (+30% AP) Health. The shrine restores 100 (+60% AP) Health after existing for 5 seconds.
Charge: Stores up to 2 charges.
Up to 3 shrines can be active at once. If an enemy champion touches a shrine, it is destroyed.

Opens a one-way magical corridor through nearby terrain for 10 seconds. Both allied and enemy champions nearby can use the corridor by tapping the turret button.
Allies travel through the corridor 50% faster than enemies.

Chimes: Gains bonuses from chimes that spawn on the map and are collected. Automatically collects nearby chimes, gaining the following bonuses:
- 24% out-of-combat Move Speed for 20 seconds (max 10 stacks, 150%)
- 400 XP
- Restores 12% of max Mana
Chimes remain for 10 minutes.
Starting 5 minutes into the game, gains 20 XP every 1 minute.
Meeps: Summons a meep that follows Bard every 7 seconds (max 1). Meeps empower Bard and grant additional effects based on the number of chimes collected.
- Consumes a meep to empower his attack, dealing 35 (+40% AP) plus 12 (per 3 chimes held) bonus magic damage.
- With 3 chimes, slows enemies by 25% for 1 second.
- With 9 chimes, also damages enemies around and behind the target.
- With 27 chimes, the area of effect is further increased.
The spawn rate, slow, and max number of meeps following him increase with the number of chimes collected.

Passive: While Static Field is off cooldown, attacks mark enemies, dealing 40 (+15% AP) magic damage after 1 second.
Active: Deals 275 (+80% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies and silences them for 0.5 seconds.
Fires his right hand, dealing 110 (+100% AP) magic damage and pulling the target to Blitzcrank.

Gains 35% bonus Move Speed that decays over 2.5 seconds.
This ability can be recast to gain 140% bonus Move Speed that decays over 1.5 seconds.
When the effect ends, Blitzcrank's Move Speed is reduced by 33% for 1 second. If this ability was recast, the slow is increased to 99% for 1 second.
Empowers his next attack to critically strike, dealing 180% AD physical damage and knocking up the target.
Upon falling below 35% Health, gains a shield that absorbs damage equal to 30% of max Mana for 10 seconds.

Releases a torrent of flame that bounces up to 5 times between enemies or himself, each bounce dealing 100 / 200 / 300 (+30% AP) magic damage. Blaze: Pyroclasm briefly slows by 30% / 40% / 50% if the target is ablaze. Bounces attempt to max stack Blaze on champions.
Launches a fireball that deals 80 / 120 / 160 / 200 (+55% AP) magic damage to the first enemy it hits. Blaze: Sear stuns for 1.75 seconds if the target is ablaze.
After a short delay fire erupts at a location, dealing 70 / 120 / 170 / 220 (+55% AP) magic damage to enemies. Blaze: Pillar of flame deals 30% more damage to enemies that are ablaze.
Ignites enemies near the target, dealing 60 / 90 / 120 / 150 (+45% AP) magic damage. Blaze: Conflagration spreads farther if the target is ablaze.

Brand's abilities set enemies Ablaze, dealing 3% of their max Health as magic damage over 4 seconds. Stacking Ablaze 3 times on champions and large monsters causes them to detonate after 2 seconds, dealing 10% (+0.02% AP) of each nearby enemy's max Health as magic damage. Enemies that detonate cannot stack Ablaze again within 4 seconds.

Slams the ground and opens a fissure, dealing 150 / 250 / 350 (+60% AP) magic damage and knocking up enemies for 1 / 1.25 / 1.5 second. The fissure slows enemies by 40% / 50% / 60% and lasts for 4 seconds. After the first enemy champion hit, subsequent enemies are knock up for 0.25 seconds.
Lauches ice that deals 60 / 120 / 180 / 240 (+3% HP) magic damage and slows the enemy hit by 70% for 2 seconds. Applies a stack of Concussive Blows.
Leaps to an ally. Braum and the ally gain 10 / 15 / 20 / 25 (+10% / 12% / 14% / 16% bonus Armor) Armor and 10 / 15 / 20 / 25 (+10% / 12% / 14% / 16% bonus MR) Magic Resist for 3 seconds on arrival.

Raises his shield, intercepting projectiles for 4 seconds. Braum negates the first instance of damage wichever direction he faces and takes 35% / 40% / 45% / 50% reduced damage afterwards. Braum gains 15% Movement Speed while his shield is raised.

Braum's attacks apply Concussive Blows for 4 seconds. Once the first stack is applied, ally basic attacks also stack Concussive Blows. Upon reaching 4 stacks, the target is stunned for 1.25 - 1.75 seconds and takes 45 magic damage. For the next 8 seconds they cannot receive new stacks, but take bonus 9 magic damage from Braum's attacks.

Lines up the perfect shot, Revealing an enemy champion for 1.5 seconds before dealing 250 / 450 / 650 (+100% bonus AD) physical damage plus 20% of their missing Health. This damage scales with Critical Rate and Critical Damage at 30% effectiveness. Enemy champions can intercept the bullet before it hits their ally. Has a range of 1750 / 2250 / 2750 .

Fires a narrow piercing bullet that deals 50 / 100 / 150 / 200 (+ 125% / 145% / 165% / 185% AD) physical damage. Hitting an enemy expands the bullet, but reduces subsequent damage by 40%. Always deals full damage to trapped or netted enemies.

Sets a trap that enemy champions can spring, immobilizing them for 1.5 seconds and Revealing them for a short duration. Headshot attacks against enemies trapped by Yordle Snap Trap deal 40 / 90 / 140 / 190 (+30% bonus AD) bonus physical damage. Traps last for 30 seconds and 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 can be active at once. Trap charging time: 25 / 20 / 15 / 10 seconds.
Launches a net, knocking Caitlyn backwards. The net deals 70 / 120 / 170 / 220 (+80% AP) magic damage and slows by 50% for 1 second.

Every 6 attacks fires a Headshot, dealing 60% - 100% AD (based on level) bonus physical damage. This damage scales with Critical Rate and Critical Damage at 100% effectiveness. Trapped or netted enemies trigger a Headshot that has double range. Attacking from brush builds Headshot twice as fast.

Leap to enemy champion, dealing 30 magic damage + 15% / 20% / 25% of their current Health, knocking away other enemies and creating an inescapable zone for 2 / 2.5 / 3 seconds. Hextech Ultimatum ends when Camille leaves the zone.

Empowers the next attack to deal 81 (130% / 140% / 150% / 160% AD) physical damage and grant 25% Movement Speed for 1.5 seconds. 1.6 seconds after the first attack, Precision Protocol automatically empowers another basic attack, dealing 40% of its damage as true damage instead. Cannot critically strike.

Slices in a direction, dealing 100 / 130 / 160 / 190 (+110% AD) and an additional 3% / 5% / 7% / 9% of the target's maximum Health as physical damage. Enemies hit by the outer half are slowed by 80% decaying over 2 seconds, healing Camille for 80% of the damage dealt to champions. Deals 95% damage to monsters.

First Cast: FIres a hookshot that attaches to terrain, pulling Camille to it. If Camille misses, it is placed on a 3 second cooldown. Second Cast: Dashes from the wall, dealing 60 / 110 / 160 / 210 (+75% bonus AD) physical damage on landing. Regardless of landing, Camille's next basic attack against enemy champions within 3 seconds, grants 50% / 60% / 70% / 80% Attack Speed for 5 seconds. If the dash hits an enemy champion, they are stunned for 0.75 seconds, and Hookshot's cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds.
Attacking an enemy champion grants a shield that absorbs 138 physical / magic damage (20% HP) for 2 seconds. The shield type is based on the type of damage the attacked target deals.

Devours an enemy, dealing: 300 / 450 / 600 (+50% AP +8% of Cho'Gath's bonus Health) true damage to champions; Deals 1200 (+50% AP + 10% of Cho'Gath's bonus Health) true damage to minions and monsters. If this kills the target, Cho'Gath gains 1 stack of Feast. Stacks gained from minions and non-epic monsters are capped at 6. Feast (per stack): Grants 80 / 120 / 160 max Health; Increases size by 6%, up to an increase of 135%; Increases Attack Range by 4.7 / 6.2 / 7.7, up to an increase of 75; Increases this ability's cast range by 2.5, up to an increase of 25.
Ruptures the ground, knocking up enemies for 1 second, dealing 80 / 135 / 190 / 245 (+100% AP) magic damage and slowing them by 60% for 1.5 seconds.
Roars, silencing enemies in an area for 1.4 / 1.6 / 1.8 / 2 seconds and dealing 80 / 130 / 180 / 230 (+70% AP) magic damage.

Cho'Gath's next 3 attacks launch spikes that: Deal 20 / 45 / 70 / 95 (+30% AP) magic damage plus magic damage equal to 2.3% / 2.7% / 3.1% / 3.5% (+0.6% x Feast stacks) x the target's max Health and slows by 30% / 35% / 40% / 45% decaying over 1.5 seconds. Vorpal Spikes width increases with Cho'Gath's size. Base damage against minions and monsters is capped at 100 (30% AP) magic damage.
Killing an enemy restores 16 (+ 2 x level) Health and 4 (+0.35 x level) Mana. The values restored are doubled if the unit is a champion, turret, or epic monster.

Fires a missile that explodes on the first target hit, dealing 70 (+65% bonus AD) physical damage to nearby enemies.
Big One: Every third missile is a Big One, dealing 140 (+130% bonus AD) physical damage with a larger area of effect and blast radius.
Charge: Gains a charge every 16 seconds, storing up to 4 charges. Attacks against champions reduce the time until the next charge by 2 (2 +200% Crit Rate) seconds.
Fires a bomb, dealing 60 (+110% bonus AD +100% AP) magic damage and granting vision of the area.
Flies a short distance, leaving a burning trail for 2.5 seconds. The trail burns enemies in it for 60 (+60% bonus AD +60% AP) magic damage per second, dealing up to 150 magic damage.

Fires Gatling Gun, dealing 20 (+55% bonus AD) physical damage per second, up to a total of 80 physical damage over 4 seconds. Reduces Armor and Magic Resist by up to 12 for 2 seconds.
Gatling Gun automatically fires at his current target.

Hextech Shrapnel: Attacks and Spellblade deal 16% bonus true damage.
The Package: After hitting enemy champions 6 times with Missile Barrage, The Package is delivered to Corki.
Picking it up grants 4 Big Ones.
The Package despawns after 15 seconds.

Leaps to execute a champion, dealing 125 (+75% bonus AD) true damage, increased by 20% per Hemorrhage stack, and applies Hemorrhage.
Killing the target with this ability refreshes its cooldown, refunds the Mana cost, grants Noxian Might for 5 seconds, and causes nearby minions and monsters to flee for 1.5 seconds.

Swings his axe after a brief delay. Enemies on the inside take light physical damage, while enemies hit by the blade take heavy physical damage. Heals for 15% of his missing Health for each champion or large monster hit by the blade (max 45%) and applies Hemorrhage.

Empowers his next attack within 8 seconds to deal an additional 30% AD physical damage and reduce the target's Move Speed by 90% for 1 second.
Killing the target with this ability refunds 100% of the Mana cost and reduces the cooldown by 50%.

Passive: Gains 15% Armor Penetration.
Active: Pulls in enemies in front of him and slows them by 40% for 1.5 seconds.

Attacks cause enemies to bleed, dealing 18 (+40% bonus AD) physical damage over 5 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times.
At max stacks, Darius gains Noxian Might for 5 seconds, gaining 32 (based on level) Attack Damage and applying max stacks of Hemorrhage at once instead of 1.
Deals 180% damage to monsters.

Summons the moon, illuminating an area that expands. Enemies in this area are slowed by 20%. During this time, Diana charges for up to 1 second, triggering Moonfall Glow when the charge is complete. Diana can move and cast abilities and spells while charging up. Diana cannot cast this ability if there are no enemy champions nearby. Moonfall Glow: Slams the moon down, marking enemies with Moonlight and dealing 100 / 160 / 220 (+80% AP) magic damage to 200 / 320 / 440 (+80% AP) magic damage based on charge time. Targets are slowed by 20% for 2 seconds.
Unleashes an arcing bolt of energy that deals 60 / 105 / 150 / 195 (+70% AP) magic damage and applies Moonlight for 3 seconds.

Creates 3 spheres that orbit Diana for 5 seconds. Upon contact with enemies the spheres detonate, dealing 20 / 35 / 50 / 65 (+20% AP) magic damage. Also grants a shield that absorbs 50 / 70 / 90 / 110 (+40% AP) damage. If the third sphere detonates, the shield is increased by 50 / 70 / 90 / 110 (+40% AP).

Dashes to a point near an enemy, dealing 40 / 80 / 120 / 160 (+30% AP) magic damage and removing Moonlight in an area. Lunar Rush's Cooldown is reduced to 0.5 seconds if it removes Moonlight from an enemy.
After casting an ability, Diana gains 30% Attack Speed for 4 seconds. Every third attack deals an additional 35 magic damage to nearby enemies.
Restores 25% of his missing Health. Also gains Attack Damage equal to 4% of bonus Health and 15% Move Speed for 10 seconds, and heals 15% of his max Health over the duration.

Throws his bonesaw, dealing magic damage equal to 20% of the target's current Health (min: 90) and slowing them by 40% for 2 seconds.
Hitting an enemy heals Dr. Mundo for 25, or 50 if it hits a champion or monster.
Deals up to 250 damage to monsters.

Charges a defibrillator for 4 seconds, dealing 20 magic damage per second to nearby enemies.
Recast: Detonates the defibrillator, dealing 20 (+5% bonus Health) magic damage to nearby enemies. If the detonation damages an enemy, Dr. Mundo heals for 15% of the damage taken during this ability's duration. If it damages a champion or monster, he heals for 30% instead.

Passive: Gains up to 30 Attack Damage based on his missing Health.
Active: Empowers his next attack to deal an additional 5 (+5% bonus Health) physical damage, increased by up to 60% based on his missing Health.
If the target is killed or is a small monster, it is swatted away, dealing the same damage to enemies it hits.

Resists the next immobilizing effect, instead losing 3% of current Health and dropping a Chemical Canister nearby. Retrieving the Canister reduces the cooldown by 10 seconds and heals for 4% of max Health (40-second cooldown). Regenerates 1% (based on level) of max Health every 5 seconds. If an enemy champion touches the Canister first, it is destroyed.

Hurls two massive axes, dealing 200 / 300 / 400 (+130% bonus AD) physical damage. The axe return to Draven when they reach the edge of the map, hit a champion or upon reactivation. Deals 5% less damage as it damages targets, minimum 50%. Upon reversal, the reduction is reset to deal full damage. Enemy champions hit whose current Health is lower than Draven's current Adoration stacks are executed.

Gains a Spinning Axe, causing his next attack within 6 seconds to deal an additional 45 / 50 / 55 / 60 (+80% / 90% / 100% / 110% bonus AD ) physical damage. The Spinning Axe bounces off the target, allowing Draven to catch and regain it. Draven can hold two Spinning Axes at once.
Gains 20% / 25% / 30% / 35% Attack Speed for 3 seconds and 50% / 55% / 60% / 65% Movement Speed for 1.5 seconds. Catching a Spinning Axe refreshes Blood Rush's cooldown.
Throws his axes, dealing 75 / 120 / 165 / 210 (+50% bonus AD) physical damage and knocking enemies aside, slowing them by 25% / 30% / 35% / 40% for 2 seconds.

Killing a unit or catching a Spinning Axe grants a stack of Adoration. Killing champions consume all Adoration stacks and grant 60 bonus gold + 3 per stack of Adoration. When Draven dies, half of Adoration stacks are lost.

Becomes untargetable and returns to where he was 3.5 seconds ago, healing for 150 (150 +50% AP) Health. The heal is increased by 3% for every 1% of Health lost in the last 3.5 seconds.
Upon arrival, deals 200 (+150% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies.

Throws a temporal device, dealing 90 (+30% AP) magic damage. On hitting a champion or reaching max range, it expands into a field that slows by 30%. The device then returns to Ekko, dealing 70 (+60% AP) magic damage.
Deals 115% damage to monsters.

Passive: Attacks against low Health targets deal an additional 3% (+0.025% AP) of missing Health as magic damage.
Active: Creates a chronosphere that lasts 1.5 seconds, slowing enemies by 40%. If Ekko enters the sphere, it detonates, stunning enemies for 2.25 seconds and granting Ekko a shield that absorbs 70 (+150% AP) damage for 2 seconds.
Dashes in the target direction. His next attack within 3 seconds gains 250 range, blinks him to the target, and deals an additional 60 (+40% AP) magic damage.

Every third attack or damaging ability against the same target deals an additional 30 (+80% AP) magic damage. If the target is a champion, Ekko gains 40% (based on level) Move Speed for 2.5 seconds.
Deals 120% damage to monsters.
Cannot affect the same target again for 5 seconds.

Evelynn briefly goes untargetable and decimates the area in front of her before warping backwards a long distance. Deals 150 / 260 / 370 (+75% AP) magic damage, increased to 230% to enemy champions below 35% Health.
Unleashes two lines of spikes, dealing 40 / 47.5 / 55 / 62.5 (+50% AP) magic damage, each to all enemies struck. Can re-cast within 4 seconds. Deals 40% / 50% / 60% / 70% damage to minions.

Curses target champion or monster for 5 seconds. Evelynn's next attack or ability will expunge the Curse adn slow them by 65% for 1 / 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 seconds. If the Curse lasts at least 2.5 seconds, expunging it charms the target for 1 / 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 seconds, If the target is a champion, shreds their Magic Resist by 20% / 24% / 28% / 32% for 4 seconds. If the target is a monster, deal additional 300 / 350 / 400 / 450 (+60% AP) magic damage. Casting Allure does not remove Evelynn from Demon Shade.

Whips a target with Lashers, applying on-hit effects and dealing 55 / 75 / 95 / 115 + 2% (+0.01% AP) magic damage of their max Health. Then gain 30% Movement Speed for 2 seconds. Entering Demon Shade enhances the next cast to pull Evelynn to her target, dealing 80 / 110 / 140 / 170 + 4% (+0.015% AP) increased magic damage of their max Health to all enemies in the way.

Enters Demon Shade after not attacking or casting for 4 seconds. Taking damage from enemy champions or turrets puts Demon Shade on a 1.5 seconds cooldown. In Demon Shade, Evelynn regenerates 17 Health (+7.5% AP) every second when she is below 320 Health. After lever 5, Demons Shade grants her Camouflage.

Fires an energy wave, dealing 300 (+100% bonus AD +100% AP) magic damage.
Deals 50% reduced damage to minions and non-epic monsters.

Fires an energy bolt, dealing 25 (+135% AD +30% AP) physical damage to the first enemy hit.
If the bolt hits a target, all of Ezreal's ability cooldowns are reduced by 1.5 seconds.
Applies on-hit effects.

Fires an orb that sticks to a champion, epic monster, or structure hit for 4 seconds.
Hitting the target with an attack or ability detonates the orb, dealing 80 (+60% bonus AD +75% AP) magic damage and restoring 60 Mana.

Blinks to the target location and fires an energy bolt, dealing 80 (+50% bonus AD +75% AP) magic damage.
Prioritizes enemies affected by Essence Flux, then the nearest enemy.
Hitting a target with an ability grants 13% Attack Speed for 8 seconds, stacking up to 4 times.

Channels for 1.5 seconds, then blinks to the target location and summons Crowstorm, dealing 30 (+10% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies every 0.25 seconds for 5 seconds. Crowstorm deals up to 600 magic damage.

Passive: While out of combat and unseen by enemies for 2 seconds, or while impersonating an Effigy, damaging an enemy with an ability fears them for 1.2 seconds.
Active: Unleashes a murder of crows, fearing the target hit for 1.2 seconds and dealing magic damage equal to 4% of their current Health, increased by 1.5% per 100 AP. Deals at least 45 damage.
If the target was recently feared, they take 200% increased damage instead of being feared again.
Damage against monsters is capped at 400.

Channels and drains the souls of nearby enemies, dealing 60 (+30% AP) magic damage per second for 2 seconds, plus 10% of the target's missing Health as bonus damage at the end.
Pain to Gain: Restores Health equal to 40% of the damage dealt (based on pre-mitigation damage).
Fiddlesticks is slowed by 30% while channeling.
Recast at any time to end the channel early. If Fiddlesticks completes the channel without interruption, this ability's remaining cooldown is reduced by 50%.
Health restored by target type:
- Champions: 40%
- Minions: 15%
- Monsters: 45%
Deals 160% damage to monsters
and 50% damage to minions.
Slashes the target area with its scythe, dealing 70 (+50% AP) magic damage to enemies in the area and slowing them by 35% for 1.25 seconds. Enemies in the center are silenced.

After a champion takedown, summons an Effigy for 3 seconds. The Effigy automatically chases the nearest enemy champion and detonates upon reaching them or when its duration ends, fearing all nearby enemy champions.
Only 1 Effigy can exist at a time.

Passive: Reduces the time needed to reveal Vitals by 0.25 / 0.5 / 0.75 seconds. Active: Revels all 4 Vitals on an enemy champion for 8 seconds and gains Duelist's Dance's Movement Speed bonus while near them. If Fiora strikes all 4 Vitals within 8 seconds, or if the target dies after she has hit at least one, restores 80 / 110 / 140 (+60% bonus AD) Health per second to herself and nearby allied champions for 2 - 5 seconds, scaling with the number of Vitals hit. Striking all 4 Vitals of a champion deals 16% of their max Health as true damage.

Lunges in a direction and stabs a nearby enemy, dealing 75 / 85 / 95 / 105 (+110% / 115% / 120% / 125% bonus AD) physical damage. Hitting the target refunds 50% of Lunge's cooldown. Lunge prioritizes Vitals and enemies it will kill and applies on-hit effects to the main target. Lunge deals 50% damage to monsters and can deal damage to turrets.

Parries all incoming damage and debuffs for the next 0.75 seconds. Then stabs in the target direction, dealing 120 / 170 / 220 / 270 (+100% AP) magic damage to the first enemy champion, slowing their Movement Speed and Attack Speed by 50% for 1.5 seconds. Riposte stuns instead of slows if it parries an immobilizing effect.

Empowers the next 2 attacks with 60% Attack Speed. The first attack applies a 30% slow for 1 second, but cannot critically strike. The second attack will always critically strike for 170% / 180% / 190% / 200% physical damage.

After 2 seconds (scales with Grand Challenge's level), reveals Vitals on a nearby enemy champion. Striking a Vital deals 4% (+0.055% bonus AD) of the target's max Health as true damage, heals Fiora for 45 Health and grants her 30% Movement Speed (scales with Grand Challenge's level) decaying over 1.75 seconds. Reveals a new Vital after striking one or after 16.75 seconds.

Throws a fish in the target direction that attaches to the first enemy champion hit and reveals them. After 2 seconds, the fish attracts a shark that knocks up the target and knocks away nearby enemies. The farther the fish travels, the larger the shark, dealing 150 (+60% AP)–300 (+120% AP) magic damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 40%–80% based on the size of the shark.
If the fish does not attach to a champion, it flops on the ground and attracts a shark at its location.
Dashes through target enemy, dealing 20 (+60% AP) magic damage and 100% AD physical damage and applying on-hit effects.

Empowers the next attack to gush water around the target, dealing 50 (+45% AP) bonus magic damage and applying Seastone Trident to enemies hit. Additional attacks within 5 seconds deal 10 (+40% AP) bonus magic damage.
Killing a unit with the first attack reduces Rending Wave's cooldown to 1 second.

Vaults to the target location, becoming untargetable while balanced on the trident. After 1.2 seconds, hops down to deal 80 (+80% AP) magic damage in a large area and slow enemies by 40% for 2 seconds.
Recast: Hops down early in the target direction, dealing damage in a smaller area and not slowing enemies.

Attacks deal an additional 24 (based on level) (+45% AP) magic damage over 3 seconds.
Deals 100% damage to monsters.

Grants Shield of Durand's passive shield for 5 seconds to all allied champions near the target and designates the position as his landing spot. After 2.5 seconds Galio arrives at the location, dealing 150 / 250 / 350 (+70% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies and knocking them up for 0.75 seconds.
Fires two windblasts that deal 70 / 115 / 160 / 205 (+75% AP) magic damage and converge into a tornado. The tornado deals 8% (+2% AP) magic damage of target's maximum Health over 1.5 seconds.

Passive: Every 12 seconds, upon taking damage, Galio gains a shield that absorbs 53 (8% / 12% / 16% / 20% HP) magic damage for 3.5 seconds. Hold: Enters a defensive stance, slowing himself by 15% for up to 2 seconds. Takes 25% / 30% / 35% / 40% (+4% AP + 8% bonus MR +1% bonus Health) reduced magic damage and 12.5% / 15% / 17.5% / 20% (+2% AP + 4% bonus MR +0.5% bonus Health) reduced physical damage. Release: Deals 40 / 80 / 120 / 160 (+55% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies and  taunts them for 0.5 - 1.5 seconds, increased with hold time.

Dashes forward until he hits an enemy champion or terrain, dealing 90 / 140 / 190 / 240 (+80% AP) magic damage to enemies and knocking them up for 0.75 seconds. Deals 85% damage to minions and monsters.

Enhances his next attack to gain 40% bonus Attack Speed and deal 15 (+ 10 x level + 100% AD +60% bonus MR) magic damage to nearby enemies. Hitting an enemy champion or epic monster  with an ability reduces this ability's cooldown by 3 seconds. This effect can only be triggered once per cast.

Calls forth the might of Demacia to execute an enemy champion, dealing 150 / 250 / 350 +15% (+0.12% bonus AD) true damage of the target's missing health. Nearby enemies take 75 +7.5% (+0.06% bonus AD) true damage of their missing health. Deals a max of 600 damage to epic monsters.

Breaks free from all slows, becoming immune to them for 0.5 seconds and gaining 35% Movement Speed for 2 / 2.5 / 3 / 3.5 seconds. The next attack within 3 seconds is empowered to deal an additional 40 / 80 / 120 / 160 (+40% AD) physical damage and silence the target for 1.5 seconds.

Passive: Gains 10% bonus Magic Resist and Armor. Active: Reduces incoming damage by 30% for 4 seconds. On cast, Garen gains 60% Tenacity for 1 second and a shield that absorbs 65 / 95 / 125 / 155 (+20% bonus Health) damage for 2.5 seconds. The shield starts decaying after 1 second.

First Cast: Rapidly spins his sword for 3 seconds, dealing 13 / 17 / 21 / 25 (+25% / 30% / 35% / 40% AD) physical damage 8 times over the duration. Every 4 levels, the number of spins increases by 1, up to 11 strikes. Recast: Ends Judgment early and reduces its cooldown by the duration remaining. Armor Shred; When a champion is hit by 6 strikes, their Armor is shredded by 10% for 4.5 seconds. Every hit refreshes the effect duration. The target nearest to Garen takes 20% increased damage.

If Garen has not recently been struck by damage or enemy abilities within the last 5 seconds, he regenerates 1.2% - 4.5% (1% + champion level x 0.3) missing Health per second. Damage from minions and non-epic monsters does hot affect this effect.

Mini Gnar (Passive): Hyper's bonus Move Speed is increased to 35%.
Mega Gnar: Knocks back nearby enemies, dealing 200 (+50% bonus AD +100% AP) physical damage and slowing them by 45% for 1.25 seconds.
Enemies knocked back into a wall take 50% increased damage from GNAR!, taking 300 physical damage, and are stunned instead of slowed.

Mini Gnar: Throws a boomerang that deals 5 (+125% AD) physical damage and slows by 20% for 2 seconds. The boomerang returns after hitting an enemy, dealing 50% damage to subsequent targets. Each enemy can only be hit once. Catching the boomerang reduces its cooldown by 40%.
Mega Gnar: Throws a boulder, dealing 40 (+140% AD) physical damage and slowing the target hit and nearby enemies by 35% for 2 seconds. Picking up the boulder within 5 seconds reduces its cooldown by 70%.
The boomerang generates 1 Rage (increases at levels 1/5/10) when it hits a champion and 1 Rage (increases at levels 1/5/10) when it hits a non-champion. Rage is only generated on the first hit on each target.

Mini Gnar (Passive): Every third attack or ability on the same enemy deals an additional 10 (+100% AP) plus 7% of the target's max Health as magic damage and grants 20% Move Speed (based on GNAR! rank). This Move Speed decays over 3 seconds.
Mini Gnar (Active): Gains 35% Attack Speed for 6 seconds.
Mega Gnar: Smashes down on the area in front, dealing 45 (+100% AD) physical damage in the area and stunning for 1.25 seconds.
Gains Hyper's passive Move Speed bonus upon leaving Mega Gnar form.
Mini Gnar (Passive) deals up to 300 damage to monsters.

Mini Gnar: Leaps to the target location. If he lands on a unit, he bounces off it and travels farther in the same direction. If the unit is an enemy, deals 50 (+6% of his max Health) physical damage and briefly slows the unit landed on by 80%.
Mega Gnar: Leaps to the target location, dealing 80 (+6% of his max Health) physical damage to nearby enemies on landing. Enemies directly beneath him on landing are briefly slowed by 80%.
If casting Hop transforms Gnar into Mega Gnar, Mega Gnar also bounces off the unit he lands on and travels farther.

Dealing or taking damage generates Rage. Using an ability at max Rage changes his abilities, and his next ability transforms him into Mega Gnar for 15 seconds.
Mini Gnar: Gains 0 (max 20) (based on level) Move Speed, 0 (max 150) (based on level) Attack Range, and 0% (max 90%) (based on level) Attack Speed.
Mega Gnar: Gains 100 (max 900) (based on level) base Health, 5 (max 60) (based on level) base Armor, 5 (max 70) (based on level) base Magic Resist, and 8 (max 50) (based on level) base Attack Damage.
When dealing or taking damage as Mini Gnar, gains (3/6/9) Rage (increases at levels 1/5/10) over the next 2 seconds. Attacking enemy champions generates (2/4/6) Rage, and attacking non-champion enemies generates (1/2/3) Rage (increases at levels 1/5/10).
If he does not use an ability within 4 seconds of reaching max Rage, he transforms automatically.
Rage gradually decays if he does not deal or take damage for 13 seconds.
After reverting from Mini Gnar or Mega Gnar, he cannot generate Rage for 15 seconds.
Mini Gnar and Mega Gnar share all ability cooldowns except Hyper's.
Hurls a potent cask that explodes when it lands, dealing 200 / 300 / 400 (+70% AP) magic damage and knocking enemies away from the explosion's center. The cask has a fixed travel time.

Rolls a cask to target location that explodes upon re-casting or after 3 seconds. Enemies hit take 65 / 120 / 175 / 230 (+70% AP) magic damage and are slowed by 30% / 35% / 40% / 45% for 2 seconds. The damage and slow amount increase over the first 1.5 seconds, by up to 150%. The cask reveals the area and deals 90% damage to minions.

Reduces damage taken by 11% / 13% / 15% / 17% (+0.04% AP) for 2.5 seconds. The next attack within 5 seconds after drinking is empowered to splash enemies for bonus 35 / 70 / 105 /140 (+70% AP) +8% magic damage of their max Health.

Charges forward, colliding with the first enemy hit to deal 70 / 135 / 200 / 265 (+70% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies. Enemies hit are also bumped backwards, stunning them for 1 second. Body Slam's cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds if it successfully collides with an enemy.
Casting an ability restores 62 (8.5% max HP) Health.

Fires an explosive shell that deals 300 / 450 / 600 (+150% bonus AD) physical damage and knocks Graves back from recoil. The shell explodes upon hitting an enemy champion or reaching the end of its range, dealing 200 / 320 / 440 (+120% bonus AD) physical damage in a cone. Enemies damaged by the shell's initial impact do not take damage from the explosive cone.

Fires a powder round that deals 70 / 90 / 110 / 130 (+80%bonus  AD) physical damage and then detonates after 1 second to deal an additional 80 / 130 / 180 / 230 (+110% / 130% / 150% / 170% bonus AD) physical damage. Detonates in 0.25 seconds if the round hits terrain. Deals 110% damage against monsters.

Throws a canister that creates a cloud of smoke for 4 seconds. Enemies within the smoke cannot see outside of it. Enemies caught in the initial impact take 60 / 125 / 190 / 255 (+60% AP) magic damage and are slowed by 50% for 0.5 seconds.

Dashes in a direction, reloading one shell and granting True Grit for 4 seconds. True Grit grants 13 / 18 / 23 / 28 Armor ( stacks 6 times) and refreshes when damaging non-minions. Dashing towards an enemy champion grants 2 stacks of True Grit. Each bullet hit reduces Quickdraw's cooldown by 0.5 seconds.

Graves' shotgun has some unique properties: Double Barrel: Graves must reload when he runs out of ammo. Attack Speed reduces reload time slightly, but reduces time between attacks dramatically. 12 Gauge: Attacks fire 4 bullets. Units hit take 72% AD physical damage +24% for additional bullets. Critical strikes fire 6 bullets and increase each bullet's damage by 50%. Structures only take 75% damage. Buckshot: Bullets cannot pass through enemy units. Non-champions struck by multiple bullets are knocked back slightly.

First Cast: Hurl a needle that deals 35 / 50 / 65 (+10% AP) magic damage, slows by 35% / 40% / 45% for 1.5 seconds, and applies Thousand Cuts to all enemies hit. Needlework can be re-cast 2 additional times. Second Cast: Fires 3 needles, dealing a total of 105 / 150 / 195 (+30% AP) magic damage. Third Cast: Fires 5 needles, dealing a total of 175 / 250 / 325 (+50% AP) magic damage.

Passive: Gains 1 stack per attack hit (max 4, lasts 6 seconds. Active: Snips her scissors twice, snipping an extra time for each stack consumed. Each snip deals 14 / 18 / 22 / 26 (+6% AP) magic damage with the final snip dealing 70 / 90 / 110 / 130 (+30% AP) magic damage instead. The center of each strike deals true damage instead and applies Thousand Cuts. Damage to monsters: 100%.

Summons the Hallowed Mist for 4 seconds, making Gwen untargetable to enemies outside the zone while inside. Gwen gains 18 / 20 / 22 / 24 (+5% AP) Armor and Magic Resist inside the Mist. The Mist will move to Gwen the first time she attempts to leave.

Dashes and enhances her attacks for 4 seconds. Enhanced attacks gain 20% / 40% / 60% / 80% Attack Speed, 10 (+18% AP) magic damage on-hit and 100 Range. The first enhanced attack to hit a champion or minion refunds 50% of this ability's coodown.

Attacks deal bonus 1% (+0.005% AP) magic damage of the target's max Health. Heals for 70% of the damage this ability deals to champions up to 12 (+7% AP). Deals a max of 2 (+3% AP) magic damage against monsters.

Hecarim summons spectral riders and charges forward, dealing 150 / 250 / 350 (+100% AP) magic damage and revealing enemies hit. Hecarim unleashes a shockwave at the end of the charge that fears for between 0.75 to 1.5 seconds, increased by charge distance.

Charges his halberd for 0.75 seconds, increasing the area Hecarim deals damage to. Automatically casts when fully charged, dealing 5 / 15 / 25 / 35 (+110% AD) physical damage. If Hecarim hits an enemy champion or a large monster with a full charge, he critically strikes them for 120% damage and gains a 18% Movement Speed bonus that decays over 3 seconds. This also empowers Hecarim's next Rampage within the next 8 seconds to deal 120% damage.

Gains 6 / 12 / 18 / 24 Armor and Magic Resist, and deals 12 / 18 / 24 / 30 (+20% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies once every 0.5 seconds for 4 seconds. For every enemy hit, he heals for 5 (+1% bonus HP). He also heals for 20% (+0.02% bonus AD) of the damage he deals to the targets Healing gained from damaging minions and monsters is reduced by 50% and capped at 90 Health.

Gains 25% Movement Speed, which increases to 55% over 4 seconds. Hecarim dashes toward the enemy if his next attack is within 5 seconds, dealing 5 / 10 / 15 / 20 (+30% bonus AD) physical damage, knocking the target back, and then pursuing them immediately after. Enemies hit are revealed. While Onslaught of Shadows is in effect, the remaining duration of this ability is paused.
Gains Attack Damage (12% of bonus Movement Speed).

Active: Upgrades his next basic ability.
H-28Q Apex Turret: Places an upgraded turret for 10 seconds that deals 80 (+35% AP) magic damage per shot, increased to 100 (+60% AP) magic damage at max charge.
Slows for 1 second on hit.
Hextech Rocket Swarm: Fires 4 waves of rockets. Each rocket deals 135 (+45% AP) magic damage to the first enemy hit.
Additional rocket hits after the first on the same champion or monster deal only 25% magic damage per hit. Once the target is hit by 5 rockets, the damage decays further. Rockets deal full damage to minions.
The rocket swarm deals a maximum of 524 (+175% AP) magic damage to an enemy champion or monster.
CH-3X Lightning Grenade: Throws a bouncing grenade that discharges 3 times, each dealing 100 (+60% AP) magic damage. The stun and slow areas are larger, and the grenade slows enemies by 40%.
Recast: Cancels this ability.

Places a turret. The turret gradually builds up charge and attacks nearby enemies.
The turret deals 5 (+25% AP) magic damage on hit. At max charge, it fires a beam that deals 25 (+55% AP) magic damage.
Up to 3 H-28G Evolution Turrets can be active at once.
Turrets become dormant if Heimerdinger moves too far away.
UPGRADE!!!: Technological enhancement upgrades this ability to H-28Q Apex Turret.
H-28G Evolution Turret Stats (based on level)
Health: 110 (based on level) (+8%–50% AP) (based on level)
Armor: 20
Magic Resist: 25
Heimerdinger's turrets take 140% reduced damage from melee champions' attacks and abilities.
Deals 40% damage to monsters.

Fires a barrage of 5 rockets that deal 60 (+60% AP) magic damage to the first enemy hit. Nearby turrets gain 20% charge for each rocket that hits a champion.
Additional rocket hits after the first on the same champion or monster deal only 20% magic damage. This damage is increased to 60% against minions.
UPGRADE!!! Technological enhancement upgrades this ability to Hextech Rocket Swarm.

Throws a grenade that deals 70 (+60% AP) magic damage in the target area and slows by 35% for 2 seconds. Enemies in the center are also stunned for 1.25 seconds.
Hitting a champion fully charges nearby turrets.
UPGRADE!!!: Technological enhancement upgrades this ability to CH-3X Lightning Grenade.
Gains 20% Move Speed while near allied turrets and turrets he has placed.

Unleashes a vision of pure despair that attaches to an enemy champion for 3 seconds. The vision expands over time, applying a 10% slow that stacks every 0.25 seconds and dealing 10 (+5% AP) magic damage per second to enemies.
At max size, the vision shatters, dealing 250 (+75% AP) magic damage.

Paints visions of disaster that deal heavy damage to enemies.
Devastating Fire:
Paints a blazing fireball that flies in the target direction. It explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing 50 (+75% AP) plus 4% of the target's max Health as magic damage to all enemies in the area.
Severing Bolt:
Paints a long-range lightning bolt at the target location that strikes after a short delay, dealing 80 (+30% AP) magic damage.
If the target is immobilized or only one target is struck, damage increases based on the target's missing Health, up to 200 (+75% AP) magic damage.
Molten Fissure:
Paints a field of volcanic eruptions that leaves lava in its path. Each eruption deals 20 (+30% AP) magic damage to enemies hit. Enemies in the lava take 20 (+30% AP) magic damage per second and are slowed by 30%. Each lava pool disappears after 2.5 seconds.
