description.en:
Paints visions of serenity that provide utility to himself and allied champions.
Fleeting Current:
Paints a current of swift waters in a line for 4 seconds, increasing the Move Speed of himself and allied champions by 30% (30 +3% AP).
Pool of Reflection:
Paints a protective pool at the target location that lasts 3 seconds, granting allied champions in the area a shield that absorbs 60 (+35% AP) damage. The shield increases over 1.5 seconds, up to 108 (+71% AP) damage.
Shields granted to allied champions other than Hwei are reduced by 15%.
Stirring Lights:
Paints 3 swirling lights that circle him. His next 3 abilities or attacks deal 30 (+15% AP) bonus magic damage on hit and restore 45 Mana.

Paints visions of torment that control enemies.
Grim Visage:
Launches a terrifying face that fears the first enemy hit for 1 second and deals 70 (+70% AP) magic damage.
Gaze of the Abyss:
Paints an abyssal eye at the target location that grants vision, locks onto the nearest enemy champion, and launches a homing missile at them.
The missile roots the first enemy hit for 1.25 seconds, deals 70 (+70% AP) magic damage, and reveals them for 2.5 seconds.
Crushing Maw:
Paints crushing jaws that deal 70 (+70% AP) magic damage to enemies hit, drag them toward the center, and apply a 40% slow that decays over 1.25 seconds.

Damaging an enemy champion with an ability marks them with his signature for 4 seconds.
Hitting a marked enemy with a second damaging ability consumes the mark and, after a short delay, creates an explosion beneath them, dealing 33–333 (based on level) (+33% AP) magic damage to all enemies in the area.
Each ability can only trigger this effect once per target.

Fires a storm of blades that deals 125 / 250 / 375 (+70% AP) magic damage and Marks enemy champions and Large Monsters for 5 seconds. The blades explode into a wall for 3 seconds upon hitting an enemy champion, The bladewall deals 100 / 225 / 350 (+70% AP) magic damage and slows by 90% for 1 second.

Dashes through an enemy, dealing 10 / 40 / 70 / 100 (+65% AD) physical damage and healing herself for 11% / 14% / 17% / 20% AD. Bladesurge's cooldown is refreshed if the target was Marked or dies to Bladesurge. When aimed, Bladesurge will prioritize targets it will reset on. Deals 150% damage to minions.

Hold: Defends with her blades for up to 1.5 seconds, taking 60% (+7% AP) reduced damage. Release: Whips the blades forward, dealing 20 / 35 / 50 / 65 (+50% AD +40% AP) physical damage, increased by up to 100% with charge time. Cannot be interrupted.

Sends a blade to target location. May be recast within 3 seconds to send another blade. The blades converge upon reaching their destination, dealing 80 / 130 / 180 / 230 (+80% AP) magic damage, stunning for 1 second, and Marking enemy champions and large monsters hit for 5 seconds.

Hitting enemies with abilities grant 3% - 17% bonus Attack Speed for 6 seconds, stacking up to 4 times. At max stacks attacks deal an additional 25 - 150 (+30% AD) magic damage on hit. Attacking enemy champions refreshes the duration. An ability grants multiple stacks upon hitting multiple champions.
Calls forth mighty winds of salvation that knock back nearby enemies and restore 50 (+30% AP) Health to allies in the area each second for 3 seconds.

Summons a powerful whirlwind that can be charged for up to 0.75 seconds. The whirlwind deals 50 (+50% AP) magic damage and knocks up enemies it touches. The whirlwind reaches max range in 0.5 seconds.
This ability stores a charge every 14 seconds, up to a maximum of 2 charges.

Gains 10% Move Speed for 2 seconds. The wind spirit automatically seeks out the nearest 3 champions within range, granting bonus Move Speed to allies and dealing 50 (+50% AP +20% bonus Move Speed) magic damage to enemies.

Creates a protective wind that grants herself and the allied champion with the lowest Health a shield that absorbs 80 (+50% AP) damage and grants 10 (+10% AP) Attack Damage while the shield holds. The shield lasts 3 seconds.
If a turret is within range, it also receives a shield.
Passive: Gains 5% Move Speed. Nearby allied champions also gain this bonus.

Heroically leaps to an enemy champion, dealing 200 / 350 / 500 (+170% bonus AD) physical damage to nearby enemies and creating an arena of impassable terrain around them for 3.5 seconds. Damage dealt by enemies within the arena is reduced by 12% / 16% / 20%. The effect ends once they leave the terrain or when it collapses. Cast again to collapse the terrain.

Extens Jarvan IV's lance, dealing 80 / 140 / 200 / 260 (+130% bonus AD) physical damage and reducing the Armor of enemies hit by 10% for 3 seconds. If the lance contacts a Demacian Standard it will pull Jarvan IV to the Demacian Standard's location, knocking up enemies in his path for 0.75 seconds.

Unleashes a regal aura that slows nearby enemies by 30% / 35% / 40% / 45% for 2 seconds, and grants him a shield that absorbs damage equal to 100 / 140 / 180 / 220 plus 5% of his max Health for 5 seconds. Absorbs 10 (1.6% / 1.9% / 2.2% / 2.5% of max HP ) more damage for each nearby enemy champion.

Passive: Gains 25% / 30% / 35% / 40% Attack Speed. Active: Throws a Demacian Standard that deals 85 / 140 / 195 / 250 (+80% AP) magic damage and remains in place for 8 seconds, granting nearby ally champions 30% / 35% / 40% / 45% Attack Speed. Tapping this ability while near a Demacian Standard will cast Dragon Strike towards it.
The first attack against an enemy deals 8% physical damage of their curren Health (5 second cooldown per unique enemy).

Passive: Deals an additional 75 / 130 / 185 (+70% AP) magic damage with every 3 consecutive attacks he haunches within 3 seconds. Active: Swings his stave, dealing 100 / 200 / 300 (+100% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies and gaining Armor and Magic Resist based on the number of champions hit. If he hits a champion, he gains 30 / 50 / 70 (+50% bonus AD) Armor and 18 / 30 / 42 (+30% bonus AD) Magic Resist. If he hits more than one champion, he gains 15 / 20 / 25 (+10% bonus AD) Armor and 9 / 12 / 15 (+6% bonus AD) Magic Resist for 8 seconds per additional champion hit. During this time, his size increases by 10%, and he deals additional magic damage with every 2 attacks instead. Deals 110% damage to monsters.
Leaps to a target unit, dealing 70 / 125 / 180 / 235 (+100% AD ) physical damage if it is an enemy.
Empowers the next attack or Leap Strike to deal an additional 55 / 100 / 145 / 190 (+60% AP) magic damage. Deals 175% damage to monsters.

Enters a defensive stance, dodging all incoming attacks and taking 25% reduced damage from champions for 2 seconds. After this duration, nearby enemies are stunned for 1 second and take 35 / 75 / 115 / 155 (+3.5% max target HP + 70% AP) magic damage. Each attack dodged increases this damage by 20% (up to 100%). Re-cast: Ends the defensive stance early to damage and stun nearby enemies immediately.
Attacks against champions and minions grant 6% - 20% Attack Speed for 3 seconds. (Max 5 stacks.)

Transforms the Mercury Hammer into the Mercury Cannon, gaining new abilities and ranged attacks.
The next attack with the Mercury Cannon is empowered to deal an additional 13 (+10% bonus AD) magic damage and reduce the target's Armor and Magic Resist by 11% (based on level) for 5 seconds.

Leaps to an enemy, dealing 70 (+140% bonus AD) physical damage and slowing nearby enemies by 35% for 2 seconds.
Deals 80% damage to monsters.

Passive: Attacks with the Mercury Hammer restore 12 Mana.
Active: Surrounds himself with an electric aura, dealing 160 (+100% AP) magic damage over 4 seconds to nearby enemies.
Deals 70% damage to monsters.

Knocks back the target and nearby enemies, dealing magic damage equal to 10% of the target's max Health (+100% bonus AD).
Deals up to 150 damage to monsters.
Transforming between the Mercury Hammer and Mercury Cannon grants 30 bonus Move Speed for 1.25 seconds.

Channels to fire 4 super shots at extreme range in a cone. The shots stop on the first champion hit, slowing it by 80% for 0.75 seconds and dealing 75 / 150 / 225 (+25% AD) physical damage, increased by 3% for each 1% health the target is missing. The 4th shot crits for current Critical Damage. Tap the cancel button to cancel the channel.

Launches a magical cartridge at an enemy, dealing 45 / 80 / 115 / 150 (+35% / 45% / 55% / 65% AD +60% AP) physical damage before bouncing to a nearby target that has not yet been hit. It can hit up to 4 targets and gains 44% damage each time it kills.

Fires a long range shot that stops on the first champion hit, dealing 60 / 100 / 140 / 180 (+40% AD) physical damage to it, and 75% of that damage to minions and monsters hit along the way. If the target champion was struck by Jhin, Jhin's allies, or Lotus Traps within the last 4 seconds, they are rooted for 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 / 2 seconds and Jhin gaines Movement Speed as though he had crit them.

Places an invisible Lotus Trap that reveals nearby enemies when walked over. It slows enemies by 30% before dealing 20 / 100 / 180 / 260 (+120% AD +100% AP) magic damage. When Jhin kills an enemy champion, a Lotus Trap will spawn and detonate where they were killed. Deals 65% damage to non-champions and champions recelty hit by another trap.

Jhin's hand cannon, Whisper, carries 4 shots before needing to be reloaded and fires at a fixed rate. (Attack speed will be converted into Attack Damage). Critical strikes deal only 80% of normal critical strike damage. The final bullet will critically strike and deal additional 11% missing Health physical damage. Whenever Whisper crits, Jhin gains a burst of 14% (+0.44% per 1% bonus AS) movement speed for 2 seconds. Attack Damage scales with Critical Rate and bonus Attack Speed.

Fires a mega-rocket that gains damage and speed over the first second of travel. The rocket explodes on the first enemy champion hit, dealing 25 (+12% bonus AD)–250 (+120% bonus AD) physical damage plus 25% of the target's missing Health as physical damage. Nearby enemies take 80% damage.
Damage to epic monsters is capped at 500.

Swaps weapons -
Fishbones: Attacks gain 80 range and explode on hit to deal 112% damage to the target and nearby enemies, but cost Mana.
Pow-Pow: Attacks grant bonus Attack Speed for 2.5 seconds. This effect stacks up to 3 times, for a total bonus of 35%.
Pow-Pow's stacks fall off one at a time. After swapping to Fishbones, only the first attack benefits from them.
Fires a shock blast that deals 10 (+160% AD) physical damage to the first enemy hit, slowing it by 30% and revealing it for 2 seconds.

Tosses out 3 chompers that arm after a brief delay. Chompers explode on contact with enemy champions, interrupting their dashes and rooting them for 1.45 seconds. The explosion deals 70 (+100% AP) magic damage.
Chompers last 5 seconds and explode automatically if no champion triggers them.

When an enemy champion, epic monster, or structure she has damaged within the last 3 seconds is killed or destroyed by her team, she gains:
- 140% decaying Move Speed
- 25% bonus Attack Speed
- Restores 10% of Mana spent
This effect lasts 6 seconds.
While Get Excited! is active, she can exceed the Attack Speed cap.
Dash to a location near an enemy champion marked by Plasma, gaining a shield that absorbs 100 / 125 / 150 (+80% / 120% / 160% AD +100% AP) damage for 2 seconds.

Launches 6 missiles that split evenly among nearby enemies, each dealing 40 / 60 / 80 / 100 (+50% AD +30% AP) physical damage. Additional hits on champions or monsters deal 25% damage. Living Weapon: Fires 12 missiles. Minions below 35% Health take 150% damage. Monster take 50% damage instead.

Fires a blast that reveals the first enemy hit, adds 2 Plasma stacks, and deals 30 / 60 / 90 / 120 (+130% AD +50% AP) magic damage. Living Weapon: Adds 3 stacks and refunds 70% Cooldown on champion hits.

Charges up for 1 second, gaining 50% / 55% / 60% / 65% (+50% / 55% / 60% / 65% of bonus Attack Speed) Movement Speed, up to 100% / 110% / 120% / 130%. For 4 seconds after charging, gain 40% / 50% / 60% / 70% Attack Speed. Living Weapon: Grants invisibility during the charge up. Attacks reduce Supercharge's Cooldown by 0.5 seconds. Charge time and Movement Speed scale with Attack Speed.

Living Weapon: Kai'sa's abilities evolve upon fully upgrading an item. Caustic Wounds: Kai'sa's attacks stack Plasma for 4 seconds and deal 4 (+1 per level) (+12% AP) bonus magic damage, plus 1 (+0.2 per level) (+2% AP) for each Plasma stack on the target. Plasma detonates at 5 stacks, dealing (15 + 5% AP)% bonus magic damage of their missing Health. Nearby allies apply 1 stack to champions they Immobilize. Plasma detonations deal a max of 400 damage to monsters.

Puts her Oathsworn into stasis and draws them to herself for up to 4 seconds.
The Oathsworn can launch themselves in a chosen direction, knocking up nearby enemies for 1 second upon hitting the first enemy champion. The Oathsworn then ricochets for a distance based on their max attack range.

Hurls a spear, dealing 70 (+110% AD) physical damage to the first target hit. If this kills the target, the spear continues onward, carrying the target's Rend stacks to the next enemy hit.
After casting this ability, she can dash using Martial Poise.

Passive: When she and her Oathsworn are within 800 of each other and both hit the same target with attacks or Pierce within 4 seconds, she deals 16% of the target's max Health as bonus magic damage. This effect has an 8 second cooldown per target.
Active: Sends a Sentinel to patrol an area. Upon spotting an enemy champion, the Sentinel follows them for 4 seconds, revealing them for 4 seconds. The Sentinel disappears after patrolling 3 laps.
Charge: Gains a charge every 45 seconds, storing up to 2 charges.
This ability's passive deals at least 75 damage to minions and executes them if their Health is below 125.

Passive: On hit, her spears linger in the target for 4 seconds, applying Rend stacks.
Active: Rips the spears from nearby enemies, dealing 30 (+70% AD) physical damage + 12 (+36% AD) physical damage for each spear after the first. Slows enemies hit by 15% for 2 seconds.
If this ability kills at least one target, its cooldown is refreshed and it restores 12 Mana.
Deals 50% damage to epic monsters.

Moving the left joystick while winding up an attack causes her to dash a short distance in that direction after throwing her spear.
When the game starts, she can choose an ally to become her Oathsworn.
The Oathsworn cannot be changed.
Once her attacks are launched, they cannot be canceled.
Dash speed and distance increase with boot tier.

Immediately enters Mantra state. Forms a ring of spirit energy at the taget location. After 1 second, it detonates, dealing 170 / 280 / 390 (+80% AP) magic damage to all enemies inside the circle and slowing them by 35% for 1 second. If enemies are hit by the outer ring, they will be knocked back toward the center.

Fires a blast of energy, dealing 60 / 100 / 140 / 180 (+40% AP) magic damage to the first target hit and surrounding enemies, and slowing them by 35% for 1.5 seconds. Mantra: Increases the destructive power of the blast, dealing 65 / 140 / 215 / 290 (+50% AP) magic damage to the first target hit and surrounding enemies. The blast leaves a field for 1.5 seconds, slowing targets by 42.5% / 45% / 47.5% / 50%, after which it explodes and deals 40 / 80 / 120 / 160 (+50% AP) magic damage.

Tethers up to two nearby enemy champions, dealing 35 / 60 / 85 / 110 (+40% AP) magic damage and revealing them for 1.75 seconds. If targets fail to break the tether, they take 40 / 70 / 100 / 130 (+45% AP) magic damage and are rooted for 1 / 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 seconds. Mantra: A new tether will be fromed between tethered targets. If there is only one tethered target, the new tether will spread toward an additional nearby enemy champion. If targets fail to break all the tethers, they take 40 / 70 / 100 /130 (+45% AP) magic damage and are rooted for an improved 1.5 / 1.75 / 2 / 2.25 seconds.

Grants an allied champion 60 / 90 / 120 / 150 (+ 65% AP) shield for 3 seconds and 30% movement speed for 1.5 seconds. Mantra: Karma focuses her power, granting a 120 / 180 / 240 / 300 (+65% AP) shield that decays over 4 seconds and 60% movement speed that decays to 20% over the same duration. An additional ring is generated around the shielded target, and the first ally champion who enters the ring will be granted the same shield and movement speed.
Every ability cast grants Karma a stack of Mantra. At 3 stacks, she enters a Mantra State, enchancing her next basic ability.

Blinks to target location and deals 80 / 100 / 120 (+30% AP +1.5% Mana) magic damage to nearby enemies. The next Riftwalk cast within 12 seconds deals 50% increased damage and costs 200% additional mana (Stacks 3 times).
Fires an orb that deals 80 / 145 / 210 / 275 (+80% AP) magic damage and silences the first enemy hit for 1 second.

Enhances his next attack within 4 seconds to gain 250 range, deal an additional 50 / 80 / 110 / 140 (+50% AP) magic damage and restore 5% (15% vs. champions) of missing mana. If the attack killed the target Nether Blade's remaining cooldown is reduced by 50%.

Deals 60 / 100 / 140 / 180 (+50% AP) magic damage to enemies and slows them by 30% for 1 second. Force Pulse is enhanced after 6 other abilities are cast nearby, dealing 40% increased damage and slowing for 90% instead.
Gains a shield that aborbs 50 (+30% AP) magic damage for 1.5 seconds when casting an ability near a visible enemy champion.

Rapidly throws blades at the 3 nearest enemy champions, dealing 400 / 600 / 800 (+260% AD +290% AP) magic damage and applying 60% Grievous Wounds. Katarina can move and throw blades for up to 2.6 seconds. Grievous Wounds reduces the effectiveness of Healing and Regeneration effects.

Throws a Dagger, dealing 75 / 115 / 155 / 195 (+30% AP) magic damage to the target and 2 nearby enemies. The Dagger then riccochets to the ground behind the initial strike point. The Dagger's time in the air is the same regardless of how many times it bounces.
Tosses a Dagger in the air and hastes Katarina by 50% / 60% / 70% / 80%.
Blink to a location near a Dagger or unit, dealing 20 / 50 / 80 / 110 (+50% AD +30% AP) magic damage to the nearest enemy. Picking up a Dagger greatly reduces the Cooldown of Shunpo.

Whenever an enemy champion dies that Katarina has damaged in the last 3 seconds, her remaining ability cooldowns are reduced by 15 seconds. Katarina slashes at all nearby enemies whenever she picks up a Dagger, dealing 55 (+100% bonus AD +34.5% AP) magic damage.
Grants an allied champion invulnerability for 2.5 seconds. Afterward, deals 150 (+85% bonus AD +60% AP) magic damage to enemies around that champion.
Launches a celestial sword, dealing 60 (+60% AD +50% AP) magic damage. Enemies hit are slowed by 26% for 2 seconds and have their Armor and Magic Resist reduced by 20% for 4 seconds.
Heals herself and an allied champion for 60 (+30% AP) and grants them 25% (+0.08% AP) Move Speed for 2 seconds.

Passive: Attacks deal an additional 8 (+5% bonus AD +15% AP) magic damage.
Active: Her next attack becomes ranged and deals magic damage equal to 7% (+0.02% AP) of the target's missing Health.
At level 9, this ability affects all enemies around the target.
Deals 60% damage to monsters.

Kayle unleashes her power as her champion level increases.
Level 1: Attacks grant 4% (+1% AP) Attack Speed for 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Gains 8% Move Speed at max stacks.
Level 5: Attack range is increased to 525.
Level 9: At max stacks, attacks fire waves of flame that deal Starfire Spellblade's passive damage.
Level 13: Attack range is increased to 575. The max stack bonus becomes permanent.

Infests an enemy champion for 2.5 seconds, becoming untargetable. When the infestation ends, deals 200 (+165% bonus AD) physical damage to the target.
Recast: Ends the infestation early.
Shadow Assassin: The cast range and exit distance are increased, and The Darkin Scythe's cooldown is refreshed upon exiting.
Darkin Slayer: Instead deals 15% (+0.13% bonus AD) of the target's max Health as physical damage and restores Health equal to 12% (+0.1% bonus AD) of the target's max Health.

Dashes, dealing 70 (+60% bonus AD) physical damage, then spins his scythe to deal the same damage.
Darkin Slayer: Instead deals 60% AD (+7% (+0.06% bonus AD) of the target's max Health) physical damage.
Deals an additional 35 physical damage to minions and monsters.

Swipes the scythe upward, dealing 105 (+120% bonus AD) physical damage and slowing enemies hit by 90%, decaying over 1.5 seconds.
Shadow Assassin: Can move while casting this ability, and its range is increased.
Darkin Slayer: Also knocks up enemies hit for 1 second.

Gains 35% Move Speed and the ability to move through terrain for 5 seconds. Restores 100 (+50% bonus AD) Health upon entering terrain for the first time.
Being immobilized, spending more than 1.2 seconds outside of terrain, or entering combat with an enemy champion ends this ability early.
Shadow Assassin: Gains 75% Move Speed and immunity to slows. Cooldown is reduced to 7 seconds.

Kayn the Shadow Assassin and Rhaast the Darkin Slayer fight for control.
Damaging ranged champions charges the Shadow Assassin, and damaging melee champions charges the Darkin Slayer. At full charge, Kayn can permanently transform at his base.
Shadow Assassin: After not taking damage from enemy champions, or after using Umbral Trespass, for 5 seconds, attacks and abilities deal an additional 52% (based on level) magic damage to enemy champions for 3 seconds.
Darkin Slayer: Damaging enemy champions restores Health equal to 24% (based on level) of the damage dealt.

Summons a storm around himself, gaining 20 Armor and Magic Resist and dealing 20 (+13% AP) magic damage to enemies in the area every 0.5 seconds for 3 seconds.
When multiple bolts hit the same target, each bolt after the first deals 10% increased damage.
A single enemy can have at most 3 Marks of the Storm applied.
Throws a shuriken, dealing 75 (+75% AP) magic damage to the first enemy hit.

Passive: Every 5th attack deals an additional 55 (+70% bonus AD +30% AP) magic damage and applies a Mark of the Storm.
Active: Shocks nearby enemies afflicted by Mark of the Storm, dealing 70 (+80% AP) magic damage.

Transforms into a lightning bolt for 2 seconds, becoming unable to attack but gaining 100% Move Speed and dealing 70 (+70% AP) magic damage to enemies he passes through. The bonus Move Speed is doubled during the first 0.5 seconds.
Gains 50% Attack Speed for 3 seconds upon exiting Lightning Rush.
Gains 40 Energy once when Lightning Rush first damages an enemy. Deals 50% damage to minions.

Hitting enemies with abilities applies Mark of the Storm for 6 seconds. At 3 stacks, the enemy is stunned for 1.25 seconds and Kennen gains 25 Energy.
Stunning the same target again within 6 seconds reduces the stun duration to 0.5 seconds.

Passive: Each rank in Void Assault allows Kha'Zix to evolve 1 of his abilities.
Active: Becomes invisible for 1.25 seconds and gains 40% Move Speed. Void Assault can be cast again within 10 seconds.
Evolved Adaptive Cloaking: Invisibility duration is increased to 2 seconds, and Void Assault can be cast up to 3 times in a row within 14 seconds.

Slashes with his claws, dealing 75 (+130% bonus AD) physical damage. Damage is increased by 110% against isolated targets.
Evolved Reaper Claws: Attacks and Taste Their Fear gain 50 range, and Taste Their Fear's cooldown is reduced by 40% against isolated targets.
Targets with no allied units or structures nearby are isolated.

Fires spikes that deal 70 (+100% bonus AD) physical damage. Heals himself for 40 (+50% AP) if he is within the explosion.
Evolved Spike Racks: Fires 2 additional spikes, revealing enemies and slowing them by 60% for 2 seconds.

Leaps to a target area, dealing 65 (+20% bonus AD) physical damage.
Evolved Wings: Leap gains 250 range. Leap's cooldown resets on champion kills or assists.

Kha'Zix's next attack against an enemy champion is empowered to deal an additional 23 (+50% bonus AD) magic damage and slow by 25% for 2 seconds.
Unseen Threat is refreshed when Kha'Zix leaves the enemy team's vision.

Lamb blesses the ground under herself for 3 seconds, creating a zone where all units within cannot be killed. When units inside the zone fall to 10% Health or below, they become invulnerable to damage for as long as they stay inside the zone, during which they cannot be healed. When the blessing ends, restores 150 / 200 / 250 Health to units within the zone and heals for 50 Health. This ability does not take effect against structures.

Rolls in a target direction and fires an arrow up to 3 enemies, dealing 50 / 75 / 100 / 125 (+70% bonus AD) physical damage and gaining 25% (+5% of Mark of the Kindred stack count) Attack Speed for 4 seconds. While in Wolf's Frenzy, this ability's cooldown is reduced to 4 seconds.

Passive: Gains Hunter's Vigor stacks when moving or attacking. After gaining 100 stacks, Kindred's next attack restores Health (Health restored is based on missing Health and level). Active: Claims an area as territory and directs Wolf to maul the last target that Lamb attacked. Wolf's mauling deals 25 / 30 / 35 / 40 (+20% of bonus AD +20% AP) magic damage plus 1.5% (+1% of Mark of the Kindred stack count) of the target's current Health. Wolf deals 100% damage to marked monsters and other surrounding monsters, slowing them by 50% for 2 seconds. Health restored is the greatest when below 30% Health. Deals up to 300 damage to monsters.

Slows and enemy by 50% (+5% AP) for 1 second. Kindred's third attack within 4 seconds of attacking an enemy directs Wolf to pounce on the target, dealing 90 / 115 / 140 / 165 (+80% bonus AD) physical damage plus 8% (+0.5% of Mark of the Kindred stack count) of the target's missing Health. Wolf's attack deals 90 / 115 / 140 / 165 (+80% bonus AD) bonus physical damage plus 12% (+0.75% of Mark of the Kindred stack count) of the target's missing Health to enemies below 25% (+40% Crit Damage) Health. Deals up to 300 damage against monsters.

Marks targets with Mark of the Kindred for hunting. Deals additional 30% damage to small monsters, Red Bramblebacks, and Blue Sentinels that are marked. There are different ways to mark a target: 1. Auto-refresh: Every 25 seconds, the Mark on a monster expires and a new one is automatically applied. Marks on monsters are highlighted on the minimap. 2. Active: Tap the Mark button above your spells to mark an enemy champion. 40 second cooldown (120 second cooldown for marking same champion) . Scoring a takedown against a hunted target grants a Mark of the Kindred stack that empowers Kindred. The first 3 stacks gained grant 75 attack range, and every 3 stacks gained subsequently grant 25 attack range. Mark of the Kindred also empowers abilities and grants them the following effects: Dance of Arrows: Gain 0% bonus Attack Speed (5% of Mark of the Kindred stack count). Wolf's Frenzy: Deal bonus damage equal to 0% of current Health (1% of Mark of the Kindred stack count). Mounting Dread: Deal bonus damage equal to 0% of missing Health (1% of Mark of the Kindred stack count).

Corrosion Specialist (Passive): Gains 10% / 20% / 30% Attack Speed. Acid Shot (Active): Shoots acid at an area, revealing the area for 2 seconds. Then deals 80 / 120 / 160 (+25% AP +75% bonus AD ) magic damage to enemies within and reveals them for 2 seconds. This ability's damage scales with the target's missing Health, increasing by 0% - 50% based on 0% - 60% missing Health. Enemies below 40% Health take 160 / 240 / 320 (+50% AP +150% bonus AD) magic damage instead. Subsequent shots within 8 seconds cost an additional 50 Mana (max 500 Mana). This ability's range increases by 200 units with each rank gained.
Vomits a corrosive projective that deals 90 / 150 / 210 / 270 (+65% AP) magic damage and shreds 20% / 24% / 28% / 32% Armor and Magic Resist for 4 seconds.
Attacks gain 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 range and deal an additional 1.5% / 2.5% / 3.5% / 4.5% (+0.01% AP) max Health as magic damage for 8 seconds. Deals up to 100 damage against minions and monsters.
Spits bile, dealing 80 / 130 / 180 / 230 (+55% AP) magic damage and leaving a trail of ooze for 3.5 seconds. Enemies in the ooze are slowed by 45% / 50% / 55% / 60% .

Icathian Gift: Can continue to move and gain 10% Movement Speed for 4 seconds after dying. The Movement Speed bonus increases to 50% over the duration. Explodes when the effect ends, dealing 105 (+35) true damage to nearby enemies.

Shatters his ntofos to knock back an enemy champion, dealing 80 / 115 / 150 physical damage , then dashes behind them and goes All Out for 15 seconds. Demolishing Strike: If the enemy would hit a wall, they are knocked back through the wall and K'Sante strikes them again for 80 / 115 / 150 (+5% bonus Health) physical damage. All Out: His basic abilities are upgraded; gains 40% / 60% / 80% Attack Speed; gains 50% bonus Armor Pen; gains 20% Omnivamp; loses 30% max Health; loses 80% bonus armor; loses 80% bonus Magic Resist. K'Sante is unstoppable and roots his target while casting this ability.

Slams his weapon, dealing 80 / 120 / 160 / 200 (+35% bonus Armor +35% bonus MR) physical damage and slowing enemies by 80% for 0.5 seconds. Ntofo Strikes: If he hits the target, he gains a stack of Ntofo Strikes for 6 seconds. At 2 stacks, he instead fires a shockwave that pulls in and stuns the target for 0.75 seconds. All Out: This ability's cooldown is reduced by 30%.

Raises his weapons, charging up for 0.3 - 0.75 seconds. During this time, he is unstoppable and reduces incoming damage by 30%. After charging up, he dashes forward, which deals 50 / 80 / 110 / 140 + 8% (+0.02% bonus Armor +0.02% bonus MR) of the target's max Health as physical damage, knocks back the target and stuns for 0.5 - 1.65 seconds (based on charge time). All Out: Refreshes this ability's cooldown; Deals an additional 10% - 80% true damage (based on charge time); Damage reduction is increased by 75% and dash speed is increased; No longer knocks back or stuns. Deals a maximum of 180 / 280 / 380 / 480 damage against monsters.

Dashes, gaining a shield that absorbs 75 / 120 / 165 / 210 (+15% bonus Health) damage for 2 seconds. If dashing to an allied champion: the distance of the dash is significantly increased and the ally gains the same shield. All Out: This ability's cooldown is reduced by 50% and dash speed is increased.

K'Sante's damaging abilities mark enemies with Dauntless Instinct. Attacking a marked target deals physical damage equal to 12% + 1% - 2% of their max Health and consumes the mark. All Out: K'Sante's attacks, active abilities, and passive deal an additional 1% (+0.01% bonus Armor + 0.01% bonus MR) of the target's max Health as physical damage. Health percent damage against minions has a minimum cap of 15 - 85. Health percent damage against monsters has a minimum cap of 25 - 95.

Delivers a powerful roundhouse kick to an enemy champion, dealing 125 (+190% bonus AD +12% bonus Health) physical damage and knocking them back.
Enemies the target collides with are knocked up for 1 second and take 125 (+190% bonus AD +12% bonus Health) physical damage.
Damage to monsters is capped at 800.

Sonic Wave: Fires an energy wave that deals 60 (+90% bonus AD) physical damage to an enemy and reveals them. Hitting an enemy allows Resonating Strike to be cast within 3 seconds.
Resonating Strike: Dashes to the enemy marked by Sonic Wave, dealing 60 (+90% bonus AD)–120 (+180% bonus AD) physical damage based on the target's missing Health.

Safeguard: Dashes to a target location. If an enemy is nearby on arrival, Lee Sin gains a 100 (+100% AP) shield for 2 seconds. Iron Will can be cast within 3 seconds.
Each attack reduces Safeguard's cooldown by 0.5 seconds.
Iron Will: Empowers the next 2 attacks to deal an additional 26 (+40% AP) magic damage and grant 20% Omnivamp.

Tempest: Deals 35 (+90% AD) magic damage to nearby enemies and reveals them for 3 seconds. Hitting an enemy allows Cripple to be cast within 3 seconds.
Cripple: Slows enemies hit by 30% for 4 seconds. The slow decays over time.
Using an ability grants 40% Attack Speed for the next 2 attacks within 3 seconds. The first attack restores 20 (based on level) Energy, and the second restores half that amount.
Calls down a beam of light, dealing 150 / 225 / 300 (+80% AP) magic damage and slowing by 80% for 1.75 seconds. Enemies in the center are stunned instead of slowed.
Empowers the next attack to stun for 1 second and deal 15 / 50 / 85 /120 (+30% AP) magic damage.

Acquiring 400 stacks of Draconic Bloodline grants Life of the Ocean, granting 20% Omnivamp while in Dragon Form.

The next attack is empowered to strike twice, dealing 100% AD and 20% AD physical damage respectively. Attacks reduce Twin Bite's cooldown by 0.5 seconds.
Dragon Form: Strikes in a wide area and applies on-hit effects to all targets.
Acquiring 100 stacks of Draconic Bloodline grants Weight of the Mountain, causing Twin Bite to slow enemies by 30% while in Dragon Form.

Deals 35 (+30% bonus AD) magic damage per second to nearby enemies and increases Shyvana's Move Speed by 30%, decaying over 3 seconds. Attacking extends Burnout's duration by up to 4 seconds.
Dragon Form: The flames expand, dealing damage in a larger area.
Acquiring 200 stacks of Draconic Bloodline grants Wings of the Cloud, causing Burnout to increase Shyvana's Move Speed by an additional 25% while in Dragon Form.

Launches a fireball that deals 60 (+30% AD +40% AP) magic damage to enemies hit and Scorches them for 5 seconds. Attacking Scorched enemies deals bonus magic damage equal to 3% of the target's max Health.
Dragon Form: The fireball explodes on impact, dealing 110 (+50% AD +70% AP) magic damage in an area and leaving a fire for 4 seconds. The fire deals 28 (+10% AD +20% AP) magic damage to enemies within it and Scorches them.
Acquiring 300 stacks of Draconic Bloodline grants Breath of the Infernal, converting damage dealt to Scorched enemies to true damage while in Dragon Form.

Slaying a large monster grants 8 stacks of Draconic Bloodline.
Champion takedowns or slaying the Rift Herald or Baron Nashor grant 15 stacks of Draconic Bloodline.
Slaying a Dragon grants 35 Draconic Bloodline.
Every 100 stacks of Draconic Bloodline empower one of Shyvana's abilities.

Drinks a potent brew of chemicals, gaining buffs and granting 30% of the buffs to the nearest allied champion for 20 seconds. - Increases AP, Magic Resist, Armor  and Movement Speed by 30 / 55 / 80. - Grants 15 / 20 / 25 Health Regen and Mana Regen. Magic damage dealt while the potion is active applies 40% Grievous Wounds for 1 second.
Toggle: Lay a poisonous trail that deals 20 / 28 / 36 / 44 (+30% AP) magic damage per second.

Tosses an adhesive that sticks to the ground for 3 seconds at the target area. The adhesive explodes on landing, dealing 50 / 70 / 90 / 110 (+25% AP) magic damage and slowing by 35% / 40% / 45% / 50%. Enemies in the area are also grounded and cannot use movement abilities. If the target is flung into the adhesive, they are also rooted.

Raises his shield and dashes toward the target, knocking aside enemies in his way. If he hits the target, he flings them behind him, dealing magic damage equal to 40 / 60 / 80 / 100 (+50% AP) plus 5% / 6% / 7% / 8% of the target's max Health. If the target is flung into Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted for 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 / 2 seconds. Deals a maximum of 500 damage against non-champions.
Draft off of nearby champions, gaining 20% bonus Movement Speed for 2 seconds. Each champion has a 10 second cooldown.

Sion becomes Unstoppable and charges in a direction; movement input changes the direction of the charge. Sion stops when colliding with an enemy champion, structure, or terrain, or when recasting the ability.
When he stops, Sion slams the ground with earth-shattering force, dealing 150 (+40% bonus AD)–400 (+80% bonus AD) physical damage based on how long he charged, and stunning and knocking up enemies for 0.5–1.5 seconds based on charge time.

Charges a heavy blow for up to 1.75 seconds.
Recast: Slams the axe down, slowing enemies hit by 50% for 0.25 seconds and dealing 50 (+45% AD)–100 (+135% AD) physical damage based on charge time. If charged for at least 0.75 seconds, enemies are knocked up and stunned for 1–2 seconds based on charge time.
Deals 60% damage to minions and 120% damage to monsters.

Sion gains a shield that absorbs 75 (+40% AP +10% Health) damage for 6 seconds. After 2 seconds, if the shield still holds, Sion can recast to detonate it, dealing 60 (+40% AP) (+10% of the target's max Health) damage to all nearby enemies.
Bonus damage against monsters is capped at 400. The shield automatically detonates after 6 seconds.

Sion fires a shockwave, dealing 75 (+55% AP) magic damage, slowing enemies hit by 50% for 2.5 seconds, and reducing their Armor by 20% for 4 seconds. Non-champions hit are knocked back. Enemies hit by a knocked-back unit take the same damage and effects.

Sion permanently gains 5 bonus Health whenever he kills a unit, increased to 20 for large unit kills and champion takedowns.
Upon taking fatal damage, Sion reanimates, fearing nearby enemies and slowing them by 90% for 1 second. After reanimating, Sion can move and attack, but his Health rapidly decays. He reanimates with 100% Health, attacks 1.75 times per second, gains 100% Physical Vamp, and his attacks deal 10% max Health magic damage. Bonus damage against monsters is capped at 75, and he deals 50% damage to structures.
All of Sion's abilities are replaced with Death Surge, which increases his Move Speed by 67%, decaying over 2.38 seconds.

Grants 15% / 20% / 25% bonus Movement Speed to nearby allied champions for 8 / 10 / 12 seconds. During this period, her basic ability cooldowns are reduced by 20% / 25% / 30%. Unyielding Valor: While the Hunt is active, gains 1 stack of Morale every time an attack or ability deals damage to an enemy champion, and 2 stacks of Morale after a champion takedown. Each stack of Morale grants 2 / 2.5 / 3 AD. At 8 stacks, grants an additional 15% / 20% / 25% bonus Movement Speed to nearby allied champions and refreshes On the Hunt's duration.

Sivir hurls her crossblade, dealing 70 / 100 / 130 / 160 (+70% bonus AD +60% AP) physical damage to all enemies it cuts through. This damage scales with Critical Rate and Critical Damage at 40% effectiveness. The higher the Attack Speed, the shorter the cast time. Deals 75% damage against non-champion enemies.

Gains 25% / 30% / 35% / 40% Attack Speed for 4 seconds. Her attacks bounce to nearby enemies, dealing 37.5% / 40% / 42.5% / 45% Attack Damage. If the first attack critically strikes, so will the bounces. Deals 70% damage to minions. Each enemy can be hit by a maximum of 2 bounces.

Gains a spell shield for 2 seconds. Heals herself for 38 ( 65% / 70% / 75% / 80% AD + 50% AP) Health and gains Fleet of Foot when she blocks an ability. If the block fails, 50% of the ability's cooldown is refunded.
Gains 55 - 70 (based on level) Movement Speed for 1.5 seconds after dealing damage to an enemy champion with an attack or ability.

Lashes his tails forward, dealing 150 / 250 / 350 (+100% AP) magic damage and suppressing the first 3 enemy champions he hits for 1.5 seconds. Champions hit are dragged along by Skarner for the duration of the suppression. If he hits at least one enemy champion: He gains 40% Movement Speed for 1.5 seconds; If Shattered Earth is active, he will cast Upheaval first.

First Cast: Grabs a boulder, empowering his next 3 attacks to gain 25% / 30% / 35% / 40% Attack Speed and deal 15 / 30 / 45 / 60 (+100% bonus AD +4% bonus Health) physical damage to nearby enemies. The third attack deals an additional 10% of the target's max Health as physical damage and slows by 45% for 1 second.

Immediately gains a shield that absorbs damage equal to 8% max Health for 2.5 seconds and triggers an earthquake that deals 50 / 70 / 90 / 110 (+80% AP) magic damage and slows nearby enemies by 25% for 1 second.

First cast: charges in a target direction, ignoring terrain; If he runs into an enemy champion or large monster, he drags them along for the rest of his charge; Colliding into a wall with an enemy in tow deals 60 / 90 / 120 / 150 (+120% bonus AD +6% max Health) physical damage to the enemy and stuns them for 1.5 seconds. Recast: Ends his charge early. Colliding into a wall with an enemy in tow reduces Ixtal's Impact's cooldown by 35%.

Skarner's attacks, Shattered Earth, Upheaval, and Impale apply Quaking to targets for 4 seconds (max 3 stacks) . At 3 stacks of Quaking, enemies take 5% - 10% of their max Health as magic damage over its duration. Deals up to 100 - 450 damage against monsters.

Smolder's mom breathes fire from above, dealing 200 / 300 / 400 (+110% bonus AD +100% AP) physical damage to enemies in range. Enemies in the center take 300 / 450 / 600 (+165% bonus AD +150% AP) physical damage and are slowed by 40% for 2 seconds. Smolder heals for 100 / 135 / 170 (+50% bonus AD +75% AP) Health if he is hit. Deals 50% damage against minions and monsters.

Belches flame, dealing 45 / 80 / 115 / 150 (+110% bonus AD) physical damage and 40% magical damage. If the target dies, 15 Mana is refunded, once per cast. Dragon Practice Empowering Effects: -25 stacks: Damages all enemies nearby the target. -100 stacks: Sends 2 explosions beyond the target that deal 50% of this ability's damage. -175 stacks: Burns the target, dealing 0% (+0.025% bonus AD) of their max Health as true damage over 3 seconds. Enemy champions that drop below 6.5% of their max HP while burning are killed instantly. This ability's damage scales with Critical Rate, increased by 7.5% damage per 10% Crit Rate (max 75%).

Lets out a flaming sneeze, dealing 65 / 85 / 105 / 125 (+60% bonus AD) physical damage and slowing by 35% for 1.5 seconds. Sneeze Blast: Hitting champions causes an explosion, dealing 10 / 35 / 60 / 85 (+55% bonus AD +80% AP) physical damage and 55% magic damage in an area. Each consecutive explosion does 75% damage. Smolder gains 1 Dragon Practice stack per champion hit. Deals 130% damage against minions and monsters.

Gains 75% Movement Speed and ignores terrain for 1.25 seconds. Boom!: While flying, automatically locks on to the lowest Health enemy in range and bombards them 5 times. Each hit deals 15 / 20 / 25 / 30 (+30% AD) physical damage and 12% magic damage. Dragon Vision: Gains expanded vision while flying. Prioritizes champions for bombarding.

Dragon Practice: Hitting enemy champions with abilities and killing enemies with Super Scorcher Breath grant a stack of Dragon Practice, which improves Smolder's basic abilities. Dragon Practice Empowering Effects: - Super Scorcher Breath: Deals an additional 30% magic damage and gains new effects at 25, 100 and 175 stacks. - Achooo!: Explosions deal an additional 55% magic damage. - Flap, Flap, Flap: Each hit deals an additional 12% magic damage and gains an extra bolt ever 65 stacks.

Passive: The aura will be reinforced for 20 seconds after casting the ability, providing a higher buff effect than usual. Active: Plays a chord that emits a soundwave ever 0.75 seconds as it travels to the target location. The soundwave deals 35 / 60 / 85 (+15% AP) magic damage and stuns enemies for 1 second. Enemies caught inside the chord are also slowed by 25% / 30% / 35%.
Deals 40 / 80 / 120 / 160 (+40% AP) magic damage to two nearest enemies. Aura: Enhances allied champions' next attack to deal an additional 8 / 13 / 18 / 23 (+20% AP) magic damage.
Heals herself and another allied champion for 35 / 50 / 65 / 80 (+20% AP). Aura: Grants allied champions a shield that absorbs 25 / 50 / 75 / 100 (+18% AP) damage for 3 seconds.

Gains 15% / 16% / 17% / 18% (+3% AP) Movement Speed for 5 seconds. Aura: Gains an aura that lasts 5 seconds. Allied champions within the aura gain 15% / 16% / 17% / 18% (+3% AP) Movement Speed. The empowered aura grants 1.2 times the Movement Speed that the normal aura does.

After casting three basic abilities for 3 times, Sona's next attack will be empowered dealing 20 - 160 (+15% AP) bonus magic damage, stunning the target for 0.5 seconds. Casting basic abilities creates a non-stacking buff aura for 3 seconds. Grants full stack of passive at respawn. Hymn of Valor-Staccato: Bonus damage increased to 8 (+6% AP) magic damage. Aria of Perseverance-Diminuendo: Reduces damage dealt by the target by 25% (+4% AP) for 3 seconds. Song of Celerity-Tempo: Slows by 40% (+4% AP) for 2 seconds. Cooldown of basic abilities will be reduced (level X 2% - 20%).
Heals all allied champions for 150 / 225 / 300 (+45% AP), increased by 50% if the ally is below 35% Health.

Calls a star, dealing 60 / 110 / 160 / 210 (+40% AP) magic damage and slowing by 30% for 2 seconds. If an enemy champion is hit, Soraka gains Rejuvenation, healing for 60 /90 / 120 / 150 (+45% AP) over 2.5 seconds. After healing any ally champion 3 times, Starcall is empowered to deal 140% damage in a larger area. Cooldown is reduced when hitting enemy champions.
Heals another allied champion for 50 / 85 / 120 / 155 (+55% AP) Health. Excess healing is converted into a shield with a maximum shield value of 50 / 85 / 120 / 155 (+55% AP).

Create a zone that deals 70 / 120 / 170 / 220 (+40% AP) magic damage and silences enemies. The zone expires after 1.5 seconds, dealing 70 / 120 / 170 / 220 (+40% AP) magic damage and rooting for 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 / 2 seconds.
Soraka gains 100% Movement Speed when moving toward allied champions below 35% Health.

First Cast: Swain frees the demon, dealing 15 (+6% AP) magic damage per second to nearby enemies and restoring 15 (+10% AP) Health to himself.
This ability can be recast after 2 seconds. While active, the recast timer resets every 6 seconds.
Recast: Deals 150 (+45% AP) magic damage and slows by 60%, decaying over 2 seconds.
Non-champion units restore 10% of the Health.
While transformed, Demon Energy gradually depletes, but it can be recharged by damaging or killing enemy champions. Champion takedowns fully restore it.

Swain extends his demonic arm to launch eldritch bolts at enemies, dealing 55 (+32% AP) magic damage to enemies in range.
Each bolt after the first deals 10 (+12% AP) magic damage (up to 95 damage).

Swain summons a demonic eye that explodes after a short delay, dealing 80 (+55% AP) magic damage.
It slows by 30% for 2.5 seconds and reveals targets hit for 4 seconds. If Vision of Empire damages an immobilized champion, it critically strikes for 50% damage.
Swain gains 1 Soul Fragment from each champion hit.

Swain launches a demonic wave that deals 35 (+25% AP) magic damage to enemies it touches. After reaching maximum range, the wave returns, dealing 35 (+25% AP) magic damage in an area and rooting enemies for 1.5 seconds.
Recast: Swain pulls in the rooted champions and gains 1 Soul Fragment from each.

Swain gains Soul Fragments when Vision of Empire hits an enemy champion, when Nevermove pulls in an enemy champion, or when a nearby enemy champion is killed.
Soul Fragments: Each stack restores (3%/4%/5%/6%) Health (3% (based on level) +0.5% AP) and increases max Health by 16.

Manipulates the 3 Dark Spheres orbiting her plus up to 4 more nearby, launching them at an enemy champion. Each Sphere deals 60 / 110 / 160 (+15% AP) magic damage. Transcendent: Increases cast range by 100. This ability executes enemies below 10% Health. If this ability kills an enemy champion, the Dark Spheres will detonate where they were killed and deal 60 / 110 / 160 (+15% AP) magic damage to nearby enemy champions.

Conjures a Dark Sphere, dealing 80 / 130 / 180 / 230 (+65% AP) magic damage. The Sphere remains for 6 seconds and can be manipulated by Syndra's other abilities. Transcendent: Stores a charge of Dark Sphere every 7 seconds, up to a maximum of 2. This ability can be cast wile moving.

Grabs the nearest Dark Sphere and hurls it at a target location, dealing 60 / 100 / 140 / 180 (+60% AP) magic damage to enemies within the area and slowing them by 20% / 25% / 30% / 35% for 1.5 seconds. If there isn't any Dark Sphere nearby, Syndra generates one and hurls it at the target location. Damage from the Sphere is reduced to 80%. Transcendent: This ability deals an additional 12% (+2% AP) true damage.

Projects a wave of force in a cone, knocking back enemies and Dark Spheres and dealing 70 / 110 / 150 / 190 (+50% AP) magic damage. Dark Spheres that are knocked back stun and knock back enemies hit along the way for 1.25 seconds, dealing 70 / 110 / 150 / 190 (+50% AP) magic damage. Transcendent: Increases the angle of the wave of force's cone by 50% and its radius to 720. Enemies can only take damage and be knocked back from this ability once per cast.

Every instance of ability damage dealt to an enemy champion grants 1 Splinter of Wrath and restores 13 mana. Syndra gains 4 Splinters of Wrath every time she levels up an ability. Up to 120 Splinters can be collected. Transcendent: Empowers a basic ability after collecting 40,60 and 80 Splinters of Wrath. Empowers Unleashed Power after collection 100 Splinters of Wrath. Transcendence: Gains 12% AP after collecting 120 Splinters of Wrath.

Creates a massive earthen wall for 4 seconds:
- The wall knocks back nearby enemies as it forms.
- Once the wall is fully formed, recasting destroys it early.
If recast immediately:
- Taliyah rides the wall as it forms.
- Moving or being immobilized ends the ride.
This ability cannot be cast for 3 seconds after taking damage from champions or structures.

Hurls 5 rocks in a target direction, each dealing 40 (+50% AP) magic damage in an area around the first enemy hit. This creates Worked Ground beneath Taliyah.
Subsequent hits against the same target deal 60% less damage.
If Threaded Volley is cast on Worked Ground:
- Costs 10 Mana and consumes the Worked Ground.
- Cooldown is reduced by 30%.
- Hurls a boulder that deals 100 (+80% AP) magic damage to the first target hit and slows enemies hit by 25% for 1.5 seconds.
- Monsters hit by the boulder are stunned for 3 seconds.
Each rock deals 20 bonus magic damage to monsters.
Each boulder deals 36 bonus magic damage to monsters.
Taliyah can move and cast other abilities while throwing the boulder.
Causes an area of ground to erupt, knocking enemies in the area in the chosen direction after a brief delay.

Scatters loose stones in an area, dealing 65 (+55% AP) magic damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 20% for 0.5 seconds.
When an enemy dashes or is knocked through the stones, they detonate:
- Deals 20 (+30% AP) magic damage.
- Stuns for the remaining movement duration + 0.75 seconds.
Damage and stun limits:
- Each enemy can take damage from detonations at most 5 times. Detonations beyond this limit deal no damage.
- Each enemy can be stunned only once per cast.
Monsters are always stunned for the maximum duration (1 second). Deals 190% damage to monsters.
Stones after the first deal 50% less damage.
Gains 5% (based on level) Move Speed while out of combat and near a wall.

First Cast: Flings out a ring of blades, dealing 90 (+110% bonus AD) physical damage to nearby enemies. Talon also becomes invisible for up to 2.5 seconds and gains 40% Move Speed.
How to recast: Tap the ability 1 second after the first cast. The ability automatically recasts when invisibility ends or is disabled.
Recast: Exits invisibility and recalls the blades, dealing 90 (+110% bonus AD) physical damage to enemies hit on the way back.
Using an attack or Noxian Diplomacy to exit invisibility causes the blades to converge on the target enemy instead.

Long-range cast: Dashes toward an enemy champion, dealing 75 (+100% bonus AD) physical damage.
Close-range cast: Stabs the target, dealing 113 (+150% bonus AD) physical damage.
If this ability kills the target, Talon restores 35 (based on level) Health and the ability's cooldown is reduced by 65%.
The higher Talon's Armor Penetration, the faster the dash and the cast speed of this ability.
Close-range cast damage scales with Critical Strike Damage.

Throws daggers in a cone toward the target area, dealing 40 (+50% bonus AD) physical damage to enemies hit.
Upon reaching maximum range, the daggers linger for 0.75 seconds before returning, dealing 60 (+100% bonus AD) physical damage to enemies hit on the way back and slowing them by 40% for 1 second.
Deals 80% damage to monsters.

Vaults over the nearest terrain or structure.
Talon cannot vault over the same spot again for 135 seconds (reduced by Ability Haste).

Talon's abilities apply a stack of Wound to enemy champions and large monsters hit for 6 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. Damaging the same target again resets the Wound duration.
Attacking a target with 3 stacks of Wound consumes all stacks and makes the target bleed, dealing 100 (based on level) (+210% bonus AD) physical damage over 2 seconds. Monsters take 90% of this damage.
The target cannot gain Wound stacks during this effect.
If a bleeding enemy champion dies, Talon gains Move Speed that decays over 2 seconds.
Places a mushroom trap that detonates when an enemy steps on it, dealing 225 / 350 / 475 (+50% AP) magic damage over 3 seconds and slowing by 30% / 40% / 50% for 3 seconds. Traps last for 2 minutes.

Deals 50 / 95 / 140 / 185 (+50% AP) magic damage and blinds the target for 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 / 2 seconds. Attacks from blinded enemies will miss their target, dealing no damage and failing to apply on-hit effects.

Passive: Grants 15% / 20% / 25% / 30% Movement Speed if an enemy champion or structure has not damaged Teemo within the last 5 seconds. Active: Rolls a short distance forward and sprints for 3 seconds. During this time, Move Quick's bonus is doubled and cannot be removed by damage.

After a delay, become Camouflaged. Moving outside of brush for more than 3 / 3.5 / 4 / 4.5 seconds ends this effect. After exiting Camouflage, gain 30% / 40% / 50% / 60% Attack Speed for 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 seconds. Camouflage: Hide from champions by keeping them out of Teemo's detection radius. Enemy turrets reveal camouflaged units near them. Attacks and offensive abilities end Camouflage early.
Attacks deal 8 - 36 (+20% AP) bonus magic damage on impact and an additional 8 - 50 (+9% AP) magic damage each second for 4 seconds.

Creates a prison of spectral walls. Enemy champions touching a wall are slowed by 99% for 2 seconds and take 250 (+100% AP) magic damage. A wall breaks on contact, and the remaining walls deal no damage and slow for half the duration.
An enemy cannot be affected by multiple walls at the same time.

Throws a scythe, stunning the first enemy unit hit and pulling it toward Thresh for 1.5 seconds. The scythe deals 100 (+80% AP) magic damage and grants True Sight for the duration.
Recast: Dashes to the bound enemy.
If it hits an enemy, the cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds.

Throws a Lantern to a target location. Allies near the Lantern can tap the Minion Button to dash to Thresh.
The Lantern also grants Thresh and the first ally that comes near it a shield that absorbs 50 (+2 per Soul) damage for 4 seconds.

Passive: Attacks deal an additional 2 (+80% AD) magic damage per Soul, increasing based on how long since the last attack.
Active: Swings the chain, pulling or pushing enemies depending on the direction of the swing. Enemies hit are slowed by 20% for 1 second and take 75 (+60% AP) magic damage.

Thresh collects the souls of enemies that die nearby, gaining 2 Armor and 2 Ability Power per soul.
Thresh does not gain Armor on level up.
Fires a massive cannonball at an enemy, dealing 300 (+70% bonus AD +100% AP) magic damage and knocking them back.
Gains 50% Attack Speed for 7 seconds.

Blasts the ground to leap to a target location. On landing, deals 80 (+80% bonus AD +50% AP) magic damage to enemies in the area and slows them by 50% for 2 seconds.
Takedowns on enemy champions, or detonating a fully stacked Explosive Charge on an enemy champion, reset Rocket Jump's cooldown.

Passive:
Enemies killed by Tristana explode, dealing 60 (+25% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies.
Active:
Places a bomb on an enemy or turret. After 4 seconds, the bomb explodes, dealing 80 (+100% bonus AD +50% AP) physical damage to all nearby enemies. This damage increases with Critical Rate and Critical Damage at 40% effectiveness.
Each attack or ability hit increases the bomb's damage by 25% (up to 4 stacks).
At max stacks, the bomb explodes immediately.
The explosion radius is doubled when placed on a turret.
Increases the range of attacks, Explosive Charge, and Buster Shot by 10 per level.
Active: Becomes unkillable for 5 seconds and gains 50 / 75 /100 Fury. Can be cast while crowd controlled.

Passive: Gains 0.3 / 0.5 / 0.7 / 0.9 Attack Damage per 1% of missing Health. Active: Consumes all Fury to heal for 55 / 65 / 75 / 85 (+30% AP) plus 1.5 / 2.1 / 2.7 / 3.3 (+1.2% AP) per point of Fury consumed.
Reduces nearby enemy champions' Attack Damage by 20% / 40% / 60% / 80% for 3 seconds. If target is moving away from Tryndamere, they will be slowed by 25% / 30% / 35% / 40%.

Dashes, dealing 80 / 120 / 160 / 200 (+100% bonus AD +80% AP) physical damage. Critical Strikes against minions, monsters and champion-summoned units reduce the cooldown of Spinning Slash by 1 second, doubled against champions. Gains 2 Fury for each enemy hit.

Gains 0.32% Critical Rate for each point of Fury. Gains 5 Fury with every attack, 10 from critical strikes and 15 from kills. Loses 5 Fury per second after Tryndamere has been out of combat for 8 seconds. Tryndamere converts Critical Rate above 100% into Attack Damage at a rate of 1 Attack Damage per 1% Critical Rate.
First cast: Reveals all enemy champions for 6 / 7 / 8  seconds. Second Cast: Channel for 1.5 seconds to teleport to target location.
Throws three cards, dealing 60 / 120 / 180 / 240 (+70% AP) magic damage.

First Cast: Start Shuffling Twisted Fate's Deck. Second Cast: Pick a card to empower his next attack. Red Cards deal 30 / 50 / 70 / 90 (+60% AP +100% AD) magic damage in an area and slow by 35% / 40% / 45% / 50% for 3 seconds. Blue Cards deal 40 / 65 / 90 / 115 (+75% AP +100% AD) magic damage and restore 60 / 90 / 120 / 150 Mana. Gold Cards deal 15 / 25 / 35 / 45 (+50% AP +100% AD) magic damage and stun for 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 / 2 seconds.

Passive: Gains 15% / 20% / 25% / 30% Attack Speed. Every 4th attack deals 50 / 80 / 110 / 140 (+35% AP) magic damage. Active: Gain 20% / 25% / 30% / 35% Attack Speed for 3 seconds. During this time, attacking enemy champions rolls Loaded Dice.
Gain 1 to 9 bonus gold upon killing a unit.

For 6 seconds gain 225 Attack Range and 30 / 45 / 60 bonus Attack Damage and transform attacks into piercing bolts that hit every enemy in a line. Subsequent targets take 15% less damage, down to a minimum of 40%.

Become Camouflaged and hasted by 10% for 8 / 9 / 10 / 11 seconds, increasing to 20% when nearby enemy champions cannot see Twitch. After exiting Camouflage, Twitch gains 35% / 40% / 45% / 50% bonus Attack Speed for 6 seconds. Ambush resets when a champion dies while infected by Deadly Venom. Camouflage: Hide from champions by keeping them outside Twitch's detection radius. Attacks and offensive abilities end Camouflage early.

Twitch throws a Venom Cask into the target area, granting vision there and slowing enemies inside by 30% / 35% / 40% / 45% (+6% AP). The area lasts 3 seconds and applies 1 stack of Deadly Venom each second to enemies inside.

Deals 30 / 40 / 50 / 60 physical damage to all enemies affected by Deadly Venom, each stack deals 20 / 25 / 30 / 35 (+35% bonus AD) physical damage and 35% AP magic damage to enemies. Enemies with maximum stacks will spread the damage to nearby targets and apply maximum stacks of Deadly Venom to them. Deals 130 physical damage at max stacks. Deals 80% increased damage to monsters. This ability can only be cast while a poisoned target is within 1200 units of Twitch.
Attacks infect enemies with venom, dealing 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 (+3% AP) true damage over 5 seconds and stacking up to 5 times. Monsters take 130% increased damage from Deadly Venom.

Fires a chem-drill that deals 100 / 225 / 350 (+70% AD) physical damage to the first champion hit and impales them for 4 seconds, slowing them by up to 75% based on their missing health. Re-cast: If the impaled target falls below 25% Health, Urgot channels for 1.5 seconds while he reels in and executes them. Upon an execution, nearby enemies are feared for 1.5 seconds. Fires an explosive charge that deals 40 / 95 / 150 / 205 (+70% AD) physical damage and slows by 45% / 50% / 55% / 60% for 1.25 seconds.

Shoots the nearest enemy rapidly for 4 seconds, dealing 10 (+20% / 27.5% / 35% / 42.5% AD) physical damage and applying on-hits at 70% effectiveness.
