Dealing a minimum of 50 damage to minions and monsters, prioritizes the champion hit most recently by Urgot's abilities. At max rank, Purge gains infinite duration.

Gain a shield that absorbs 70 / 100 / 130 / 160 (+150% AD +15 bonus HP) damage for 4 seconds and charges forward, dealing 90 / 130 / 170 / 210 (+100% AD) physical damage and stunnng them for 1.5 seconds. Flings the first enemy champion over him and knocks non-champions aside.

Urgot's attacks and Purge periodically trigger blasts from his leg cannons, dealing 31 (60% / 75% / 90% / 105% AD) + 3% / 4% / 5% / 6% of the target's max health as physical damage. (15 / 8 / 4 / 2 second cooldown per leg) Deals 120 max damage against monsters.

Flings out a tendril of corruption that deals 150 / 250 / 350 (+85% AP) magic damage and roots the first enemy champion hit for 2 seconds. The corruption then spreads toward nearby enemy champions, also immobilizing them on contact. Immobilized units gain 3 Blight stacks over the next 1.5 seconds.

Hold: Draws the bow, gradually increasing the range and damage for the next shot. Movement Speed is slowed by 20% while preparing to shoot. Release: Fires an arrow, dealing 80 / 140 / 200 / 260 (+110% / 120% / 130% / 140% AD) to 120 / 210 / 300 / 390 (+165% / 180% / 195% / 210% bonus AD) physical damage, reduced by 15% per enemy hit ( minimum 33%).

Passive: Attacks deal 15 / 25 / 35 / 45 (+35% AP) magic damage and apply Blight for 6 seconds ( stacks 3 times). Varus' other abilities detonate Blight, dealing 3% / 3.5% / 4% / 4.5% (+0.012% AP) magic damage of the target's max Health per stack. Detonating Blight on enemy champions or epic monsters reduces his basic ability cooldowns by 13% per stack. Active: Varus's next Piercing Arrow deals 6% - 9% of the target's missing Health as bonus magic damage, increased by 0% to 50% based on charge time. Detonating Blight on monsters deals up to 120 damage per stack.

Fires a hail of arrows that deal 70 / 115 / 160 / 205 (+90% AD) physical damage and desecrates the ground for 4 seconds. Desecrated ground slows enemies by 25% and applies 40% Grievous Wounds. Grievous Wounds reduces the effectiveness of Healing and Regeneration effects.

On champion takedowns, gains: - 55% Attack Speed that can exceed the Attack Speed cap - Attack Damage = 20 x bonus AS. - Ability Power = 20 x bonus AS. On non-champion takedowns, gains: - 20% / 25% / 30% Attack Speed - Attack Damage = 10 x bonus AS. - Ability Power = 10 x bonus AS. These bonuses last 5 seconds.

Gains 30 / 40 / 50 Attack Damage and strengthens Night Hunter and Tumble for 8 / 10 / 12 seconds. When an enemy champion damaged by Vayne dies within 3 seconds, Final Hour's duration is extended by 4 seconds, up to an additional 8 / 10 / 12 seconds.
Dashes forward and empowers her next attack to deal an additional 24 (50% / 60% / 70% / 80% AD) physical damage. Final Hour: Gains 1 second of invisibility on cast. Tumble does not go through walls.

Passive: Every third consecutive attack or ability on the same target deals additional 6% / 7% / 8% / 9% true damage of the enemy's maximum Health. Active: Gains 10% / 15% / 20% / 25%  Attack Speed and 10% Omnivamp for 3 seconds. Passive deals at least 50 / 65 / 80 / 95 true damage. Passive damage is capped at 200 against monsters.

Fires a bolt that deals 50 / 80 / 110 / 140 (+55% AD) physical damage and knocks back. If enemies are knocked into a wall, they take an additional 105 / 145 / 185 / 225 (+75% AD) physical damage and are stunned for 1.5 seconds.
Gain 10 Movement Speed when moving towards enemy champions. Final Hour: Gains 70 Movement Speed instead.

Veigar blasts an Enemy Champion with primal magic to deal 185 / 250 / 315 (+75% AP) magic damage to them, increased by 0% - 100% based on the target's missing health. Deals max damage to enemies below 35% health.
Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy, dealing 65 / 125 / 185 / 245 (+55% / 60% / 65% / 70% AP) magic damage to the first two enemies hit.
Veigar summons dark matter from the sky, dealing 100 / 160 / 220 / 280 (+95% AP) magic damage. Every 50 stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce this ability's cooldown by 10%.

Veigar creates a cage that stuns enemies that pass through for 1.75 / 2 / 2.25 / 2.5 seconds. The cage lasts for 3 seconds. Veigar's Dark Matter auto casts will prioritize targets stunned by Event Horizon.
Striking an enemy champion with an ability grants Veigar a stack of Phenomenal Evil. Takedowns grant an additional 5 stacks. Phenomenal Evil gives Veigar 1 ability power per stack.

Passive: Marks enemies with max stacks of Deconstruction as Researched.
Active: Fires a beam in the direction of the joystick, dealing a total of 450 (+125% AP) magic damage over 2.5 seconds and slowing by 20%.
Enemies hit by the beam gain one stack of Deconstruction every 0.7 seconds.
Researched enemies take an equal amount of true damage instead.

Fires a plasma bolt that deals 80 (+75% AP) magic damage and slows by 70%, decaying over 1 second.
At max range or on hitting a target, the bolt splits at a 90 degree angle. Recasting this ability splits the bolt immediately.
Killing an enemy with this ability restores 20 Mana.

Opens a rift to the Void, dealing 30 (+20% AP) magic damage to enemies on it. After a brief delay, the rift erupts, dealing 45 (+25% AP) magic damage.
Charge: Gains a charge every 16 seconds, storing up to 2 charges.

Causes a target area to explode, dealing 70 (+30% AP) magic damage to enemies within and knocking them up for 0.75 seconds.
Casting this ability near Vel'Koz creates an anomaly that knocks back nearby enemies. The closer the cast is to Vel'Koz, the further enemies are knocked back.

Hitting an enemy with an ability applies a stack of Deconstruction for 7 seconds. Enemies with 3 stacks of Deconstruction take 20 + 8 (based on level) (+45% AP) true damage.
Attacks refresh the duration of Deconstruction.

Shadow excitedly surges forward, dealing 75 (+20% AP) magic damage to the first enemy champion hit and marking them for 4 seconds.
Recast: Dashes to the marked champion, dealing 150 (+50% AP) magic damage on arrival.
If the marked champion dies within 6 seconds of taking damage from this ability, its cooldown is temporarily reset.

Launches a wave of mist that deals 60 (+65% AP) magic damage. After a delay, the wave becomes smaller and faster.
Consumes Gloom on enemies hit.

Gains a shield that absorbs 50 (+70% AP) damage for 2.5 seconds and emits a shockwave that deals 65 (+30% AP) magic damage.
Consumes Gloom on enemies hit.

Sends Shadow flying to a target location. On arrival, it deals 50 (+40% AP) magic damage and slows by 30% for 2 seconds.
Applies Gloom to enemies hit.
Enemies Feared by this ability move away from the center of the area rather than from Vex. The area grows larger the further from Vex it is cast.

Every 22 (based on level) seconds, Vex becomes afflicted with Doom, causing her next attack to interrupt dashes and Fear enemies for 0.75 seconds.
Whenever a nearby enemy dashes or blinks, Vex marks them with Gloom for 6 seconds. Vex's next attack against a Gloomed enemy deals an additional 26 (based on level) (+25% AP) magic damage and reduces this ability's cooldown by 25%.
Non-champion targets take 40% (based on level) damage and reduce this ability's cooldown by 10%.

Chases down an enemy champion, knocking them up for 1.25 second and dealing 150 / 300 / 450 (+140% AD) physical damage. Vi Reveals her target and cannot be stopped while chasing it down. Enemies in the way are knocked aside and take 75% of the damage.

Hold: Charges up a powerful punch, slowing Movement Speed by 15% while increasing the punch's damage and dash distance. Cast: Dashes forward dealing 60 / 95 / 130 / 165 (+60% bonus AD) to 120 / 190 / 260 / 330 (+120% bonus AD) physical damage and applying Denting Blows to all enemies hit. Colliding with an enemy champion stops the punch and knocks them back. Deals 75% damage to minions and monsters.

Passive: Hitting an enemy with an attack or ability grants a stack of Blast Shield, up to 5 stacks. Active: Generates a shield that aborbs 60 / 85 / 110 / 135 damage for 3 seconds. Each stack consumed adds 10 (1.5% / 2% / 2.5% / 3% max HP) to the shield. At max stacks also grants a burst of 47% Movement Speed. Blast Shield stacks fall off one at a time and a max of 1 stack is added per attack or ability.

Empowers Vi's next attack to deal 20 / 45 / 70 / 95 (+15% AD +70% AP) bonus physical damage to the target and enemies behind it. Vi stores a new charge every 11 / 10 / 9 / 8 seconds and can hold 2 charges at once.

Every 3rd attack on the same enemy deals 4.8% - 9% (+0.03% AD) bonus physical damage of their max Health, reduces their Armor by 20%, and grants Vi 27% Attack Speed for 4 seconds. Deals 300 max damage vs. monsters.

Teleports to a nearby target location, dealing 120% AD physical damage to all champions in the area on arrival. This damage increases with Critical Rate and Critical Damage at 50% effectiveness.
On arrival, targets the champion with the lowest percentage of Health, dealing bonus physical damage equal to (14% +5% bonus AD) of their missing Health and slowing them by 99% for 0.25 seconds.
Other nearby enemies are knocked back.
Heartbreaker applies on-hit effects to the primary target and ability effects to everything else.

Passive:
Attacks deal bonus physical damage equal to 2% of the target's current Health.
Viego's first attack against an enemy he damaged with an ability within the last 5 seconds strikes twice. The second strike deals 15% AD +15% AP physical damage and heals Viego for 135% of the damage dealt. This strike can critically strike, and its damage increases with Critical Damage.
Passive bonuses are kept during Possession.
Active:
Stabs forward, dealing 25 (+70% AD) physical damage. This damage increases with Critical Rate and Critical Damage at 60% effectiveness.
The on-hit bonus damage based on the target's current Health deals at least 10 damage.
This ability's cast time is reduced by Attack Speed.

Charge: Gathers Black Mist and charges for up to 3 seconds, slowing himself by 10% while charging.
Cast: Dashes forward and hurls the ball of gathered Black Mist, dealing 80 (+90% AP) magic damage to the first enemy hit and stunning them for 0.4–1.25 seconds based on charge time.

Sends forth a specter to haunt the first terrain hit with Black Mist for 8 seconds.
While inside the Black Mist, Viego becomes camouflaged and gains 25% (25 +0.04% AP) Move Speed and 35% Attack Speed.

The souls of champions that die within 3 seconds of being damaged by Viego become wraiths that remain in place for 8 seconds. Viego can channel for 1 second to Possess a wraith for 10 seconds. During Possession:
- Becomes untargetable
- Can cast Heartbreaker once at no cost
- Gains 10% Move Speed when moving toward enemy champions
- Gains access to the Possessed champion's basic abilities, attacks, and items
- Heals for 5% (5 +4% bonus AD +2% AP +5% per 100% bonus Attack Speed) of the target's max Health
Viego cannot use the Possessed champion's enchantment item actives.

Conjures an Arcane Storm at the target location for 5.5 seconds, dealing 100 (+60% AP) magic damage to enemies in the area and interrupting their channeled abilities. The storm then deals 50 (+40% AP) magic damage per second to enemies within it.
After casting, drag the ability button to move the storm.
Upgrade - Howl: Arcane Storm moves faster. Champion takedowns empower the storm, extending its duration by 3.5 seconds and increasing its area of effect. The storm can be empowered up to 5 times.
The closer the storm is to Viktor, the faster it moves.

Blasts an enemy, dealing 45 (+30% AP) magic damage and gaining a shield that absorbs up to 30 (+15% AP) damage for 2.5 seconds.
The next attack within 3.5 seconds deals 20 (+100% AD +40% AP) bonus magic damage.
Upgrade - Turbocharge: This ability's shield absorbs up to 50 (+25% AP) damage, and Viktor gains 30% Move Speed for 2.5 seconds.

Deploys a Gravity Field for 4 seconds, slowing enemies within by 25%. After a short delay, the field applies a stack of Gravitation to targets every 0.5 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.
At 3 stacks, all stacks are consumed to stun the target for 1.5 seconds. The target then becomes briefly immune to Gravitation.
Upgrade - Slow: The first time Siphon Power, Hextech Ray, or Arcane Storm damages an enemy, it slows them by an additional 20%.

Fires a chaos beam that sweeps across the field in a line, dealing 75 (+30% AP) magic damage to enemies hit.
Upgrade - Blastquake: After a brief delay, an explosion follows the beam's path, dealing 30 (+60% AP) magic damage.
Controls
Tap: Automatically finds and attacks a nearby target based on the auto-aim settings.
Drag: Drag the ability button to set the beam's starting point. The ability then automatically finds and attacks a nearby target based on the auto-aim settings.
Precision Cast:
1. Drag the ability button to set the beam's starting point. Keep holding until the ability is ready.
2. To confirm, tap the checkmark in the upper left, or wait for the time limit to expire if the manual aim time limit setting is enabled. To cancel, tap the Back button in the upper left.
3. Drag the ability button to aim the beam in the desired direction. Release to cast.

Gains Hex Fragments whenever Viktor kills an enemy:
- Killing a minion or normal monster grants 3 Hex Fragments.
- Killing an epic monster, siege unit, or super minion grants 5 Hex Fragments.
- Champion takedowns grant 25 Hex Fragments.
Every 100 Hex Fragments permanently upgrades one active ability.
When all basic abilities are upgraded, the Hexcore is perfected, empowering Arcane Storm.

Infects an area with a toxic plague that infects enemies hit for 4 seconds, after with the plague explodes, dealing 150 / 250 / 350 (+70% AP) magic damage to infected targets. Also deals 10% of the damage taken by the targets during the infection period as bonus magic damage. After 0.4 seconds, the first infected enemy champion restores 150 / 250 / 350 (+70% AP) Health to Vladimir. Every subsequent champion provides 40% healing.

Drains life from enemies, dealing 70 / 100 / 130 / 160 (+60% AP) magic damage and restoring 15 / 20 / 25 / 30 (+35% AP) Health. When this ability's cooldown ends, generates a stack of Bloodthirst. At 2 stacks, gain 10% bonus Movement Speed for 0.5 seconds and enters Crimson Rush for 2.5 seconds, gradually depleting all Bloodthirst stacks over this time. Crims Rush: While in this state, empowers the next cast of Transfusion to deal 85% bonus damage and heal himself for 30 - 170 + (5% +0.03% AP)  of missing Health. When cast, consumes all Bloodthirst stacks and ends Crimson Rush. The empowered version of this ability heals for 35% against minions.

Sinks into a blood pool, becoming untargetable for 2 seconds. Also gains 27.5% bonus Movement Speed that gradually decays over 1 second. While the blood pool is active, enemies within the blood pool take 20 / 40 / 60 / 80 (+2% of Maximul Health) magic damage every 0.5 seconds and are slowed by 40%. Also restores Health equal to 15% of the damage dealt.

Charges for up to 1.5 seconds at the cost of 2 - 8% of his Health, dealing 30 / 50 / 70 / 90 (+35% AP +3% of max Health) magic damage to nearby enemies, increased by up to 100% after charging. Charging for 1 second or more consumes the max possible Health cost, but if he is below 12% of his Health, charging will not cost any Health. After charging for 1 second, he becomes slowed by 20% and also slows enemies hit by 40% / 45% / 50% / 55%.
Gains Ability Power equal to 5% of Health and Bonus Health equal to 150% Ability Power. (Both effects do not mutually stack)

Volibear transforms and leaps, gaining 175 / 350 / 525 Health and 50 Attack Range for the next 12 seconds. Upon landing, Volibear cracks the earth, Disabling nearby towers for 3 seconds and dealing 300 / 500 / 700 (+100% AP +210% bonus AD) physical damage to them. Nearby enemies are Slowed by 50%, decaying over 1 second. Enemies directly underneath Volibear suffering

Volibear gains 10% / 15% / 20% / 25% Move Speed, increased to 20% / 30% / 40% / 50% towards enemy champions for the next 4 seconds. While active, Volibear's next Attack deals 15 / 40 / 65 / 90 (+100% bonus AD) physical damage and Stuns the target for 1 second. If Volibear becomes Immobilized before he Stuns a target, Thundering Smash's duration is paused.

Volibear mauls an enemy, dealing 5 / 30 / 55 / 80 (+100% AD + 6.5% bonus HP) physical damage. If Volibear maul's a champion or Large Monster he goes into a Frenzy for 8 seconds. If this Ability is used when in a Frenzy, its damage is increased to 8 / 48 / 88 / 128 (+160% AD + 10.4% bonus HP) physical damage and Volibear restores 10 + 10% (7%) missing Health. This Ability applies on-hit effects. Base Health Regeneration: 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 (+5% / 6% / 7% / 8% lost Health). Damage ratio to monsters: 80% .

Volibear summons a thundercloud that fire a lightning bolt, dealing 80 / 110 / 140 / 170 (+50% AP) + 11% max Health magic damage and Slowing by 40% for 2 seconds. If Volibear is inside the blast zone, he gains a 131 (75% AP) + 14% max Health Shield for 2.5 seconds. Damage against non-champions is capped at 150 / 250 / 350 / 450.

Volibear gains 5% (+4% AP) Attack Speed for 6 seconds whenever he deals damage with an Ability or Attack, stacking up to 5 times. At 5 stacks, Volibear's claws ignite with lightning, causing his Attacks to deal an additional 12 - 68 (+40% AP) magic damage to the target and 4 closest enemies.

Leaps a long distance based on his Movement Speed, suppressing the first champion hit for 1.5 seconds during channel. During the channel, hits the target three times with basic attacks that trigger on-hit effects, dealing (100/275/450)+167% Bonus AD magic damage. Heals for 100% of damage dealt during the channel.

Lunges forward and bites the target enemy, dealing 70 (120% AD + 85% AP) magic damage + 6% / 7% / 8% / 9% of the target's max health and healing for 42.5% / 55% / 67.5% / 80% of damage dealt. Drag: Warwick leaps behind targets and follows their movement. The bonus damage is capped at 100 / 125 / 150 / 175 against monsters. Deal 50% extra damage to minions and restores 50% of cooldown when killing minions.

Passive: Marks enemy champions below 50% health, gaining 40% / 45% / 50% / 55% Movement Speed towards them and gaining 60% / 70% / 80% / 90% Attack Speed against any enemy below 50% health. These bonuses are enhanced to 150% of their value against targets below 35% health. Active: Briefly senses all enemies and marks the closest champion for 8 seconds. Can not be used while in combat with champions. Casting increases Warwick's vision range, which ignores terrain (up to 1300). Warwick can only passively sense enemies who were brought below 50% Health by allies. Increase sease range of active casting.

Warwick gains 35% / 40% / 45% / 50% damage reduction for 2.5 seconds. After it ends, Warwick howls, fearing nearby enemies and causing them to flee from him for 1 second, during which they are slowed by 90%. Recast: End the ability early. Recasting Primal Howl within 1s does not trigger fear effect, and 45% cooldown is returned; if fear is triggered, then no cooldown reduction.
Attacks deal an additional 12 - 46 (+15% bonus AD +10% AP) magic damage on hit. While below 50% health, heal for 100% of the damage dealt.

Extends his staff and spins to gain 20% Movement Speed, dealing 149 (220% AD) physical damage + 10% / 14% / 18% of enemies' max health over 2 seconds. Enemies that are hit for the first time are knocked up. Cyclone can be recast once within 8 seconds.

Passive: Golden Staff adds an empowering effect on Wukong's base attacks every 12 seconds. Takedowns will reduce Golden Staff's passive Cooldown by 2 seconds. The Cooldown of the passive will be reduced by 2 seconds per level, and killing enemy champions will refresh the Cooldown. Active: Empowers his next attack to deal 60 / 90 / 120 / 150 (+35% / 40% / 45% / 50% AD) physical damage. Wukong and his clones attacks reduce Golden Staff's cooldown by 0.5 seconds. After casting this ability, Wukong's next attack gains bonus range.

Becomes invisible for 1 second and dashes forward, leaving behind a clone for 3 / 3.5 / 4 / 4.5 seconds that attacks nearby enemies for 20% / 30% / 40% / 50% damage. The clone will mimic Wukong's Golden Staff, Nimbus Strike and Cyclone. The clone can move with the joystick control.

Moves toward a target while sending clones to 2 additional enemies nearby, dealing 70 / 110 / 150 / 190 (+80% bonus AD) physical damage to each enemy. After hitting the targeted enemy, Wukong gains 25% / 35% / 45% / 55% Attack Speed for 4 seconds.
Gains a stack of Stone Skin whenever Wukong damage enemy champions, stacking up to 3 times. Each stack grants 11 Armor and heals for 1.75% of his max Health per 5 seconds.
Leaps into the air, becoming untargetable and throwing out a fan of daggers which deal 150 / 250 / 350 (+100% bonus AD) physical damage and leave behind a line of Feathers. Can move while in the air.
Throws two daggers dealing 50 / 75 / 100 / 125 (+50% bonus AD) physical damage each and leaving two Feathers. Targets hit after the first take 50% damage.

Creates a storm of blades for 4 seconds that grants 40% / 45% / 50% / 55% Attack Speed and causes attacks to deal 25% more damage. If Deadly Plumage strikes an enemy champion, gain 30% Movement Speed for 1.5 seconds. If Rakan is nearby he will also gain the effects of this skill.

Calls back all Feathers, dealing 70 / 80 / 90 /100 (+50% bonus AD) physical damage to enemies they pass through. This damage scales with Critical Rate and Critical Damage at 50% effectiveness. Hitting an enemy with 3 Feathers roots them for 1.25 seconds. Minions take 50% damage from Bladecaller.

After using an ability, Xayah's next 3 attacks will hit all enemies along their path and drop Feathers she can recall. Xayah can store up to 5 Feathers at a time. Lover's Leap - Xayah and Rakan can join each other's recall. Both will reach the Summoning Platform when the initiator's recall ends.

Passive: The last champion hit by an attack or Audacious Charge becomes Challenged.
Active: Sweeps his spear, dealing 75 (+100% bonus AD +80% AP) + 15% of the enemy's max Health as physical damage and knocking back all enemies except the Challenged one. For the next 5 seconds, blocks damage from enemies far away.
Deals up to 600 damage to monsters.

Empowers the next 3 attacks to deal an additional 20 (+40% bonus AD) physical damage and reduce other abilities' cooldowns by 1 second.
The third attack knocks the target up for 0.75 seconds.

Slashes with his spear, dealing 40 (+50% AD) physical damage and slowing by 50% for 1.5 seconds.
Then immediately thrusts his spear, dealing 40 (+75% AD) physical damage and slowing by 50% for 1.5 seconds.
The furthest enemy champion or large monster hit is Challenged for 3.5 seconds, increasing Audacious Charge's range against it.
Attack Speed reduces cast time.
Deals 50% damage to minions.

Dashes to an enemy, dealing 55 (+80% AP) magic damage to all nearby enemies and slowing them by 30% for 0.5 seconds. Gains 45% Attack Speed for 5 seconds.
This ability's range is increased against a Challenged target.
Every third attack deals an additional 22% AD physical damage and heals Xin Zhao for 7 (+10% AD +40% AP) Health.

Blinks to an Airborne enemy champion, dealing 200 (+150% bonus AD) physical damage and holding all Airborne enemies in the area in the air for an additional 1.3 seconds. Grants maximum Flow but resets all stacks of Gathering Storm from Steel Tempest.
For the next 15 seconds, Yasuo's Critical Strikes gain 55% bonus Armor Penetration (affects only the target's bonus Armor).

Thrusts forward, dealing 20 (+105% AD) physical damage. On hit, grants a stack of Gathering Storm. At 2 stacks, Steel Tempest launches a whirlwind that knocks enemies up.
When used during Sweeping Blade's dash:
Steel Tempest strikes in a circle.
Steel Tempest is treated as an attack. It can critically strike for 90% critical damage and applies on-hit effects to all units hit.
Cooldown and cast time are reduced by Attack Speed.
Creates a 300 unit wall that blocks all enemy projectiles for 4 seconds.

Dashes through an enemy, dealing 70 (+20% bonus AD +60% AP) magic damage. Each cast increases the next dash's base damage by 25%, up to +75%.
Cannot be used on the same enemy for 7 seconds.
Tapping Steel Tempest during this dash makes it strike in a circle.

Resolve:
Moving builds Flow, which is shown on the resource bar. At max Flow, taking damage from a champion or monster grants a shield that absorbs 77 (based on level) damage for 1 second.
Intent:
Yasuo's Critical Rate is doubled, but his Critical Strikes deal 90% critical damage.
Critical Rate above 100% is converted into bonus Attack Damage at a rate of 0.5 per 1%.
Strikes all enemies along a path for 200 / 375 / 550 (+60% AD) physical and magic damage, teleport behind the last champion hit and knocking them towards Yone.

Thrusts forward, dealing 30 / 50 / 70 / 90 (+175% AD) physical damage. Grants a stack of Gathering Storm if the thrust damages an enemy. At 2 stacks, Mortal Steel dashes Yone forward and launches a whirlwind that knocks enemies Airborne. Mortal Steel is treated as an attack: it can Critically Strike for bonus damage and applies on-hit effects to all units hit. Cooldown and cast time are reduced by Attack Speed. Deal 70% damage to monsters.

Cleaves in a cone, dealing 20 / 35 / 50 / 65 plus 9% / 10% / 11% / 12% of the target's maximum Health as physical and magic damage. Gains a shield that absorbs 40 / 55 / 70 / 85 (+60% bonus AD) damage for 1.5 seconds if Spirit Cleave hits an enemy, increased by 100% on hitting a champion and 40% on subsequent champion hits. Deals 60 minimum damage against minions. Deals 30 maximum damage against monsters. Cooldown aand cast time are reduced by Attack Speed.

Dashes forward, entering Spirit Form and leaving his body behind for 5 seconds. During Spirit Form, Yone gains 10% Movement Speed that increases over the duration and marks champions damaged with his attacks or abilities. When Soul Unbound ends, Yone returns to his body and marked enemies take 27.5% / 30% / 32.5% / 35% of the damage Yone dealt to them as true damage. Re-cast: End Soul Unbound early.

Steel and Spirit: Every other attack deals 50% of the attack's damage as magic damage instead. Intent: Yone's Critical Rate is doubled, but his Critical Strikes deal 90% of normal critical strike damage. Yone converts Critical Rate above 100% into Attack Damage at a rate of 0.5 Attack Damage per 1% Critical Rate.

Passive: Arc of Ruin's base damage and Untouchable Shadow's dash speed scale with this ability's level. Transcendent State (Active): Enters a Transcendent State for 15 seconds. During this time, Yunara's basic abilities are empowered and cost no Mana. Cultivation of Spirit: Activates automatically for the duration. Arc of Judgment: Upgrades to Arc of Ruin. Its remaining cooldown reduces by 80% when Yunara enters or exits a Transcendent State. Kanmei's Steps: Upgrades to Untouchable Shadow. Its cooldown refreshes when Yunara enters or exits a Transcendent State.

Spirit Charge (Passive): Attacks deal an additional 10 / 15 / 20 / 25 (+20% AP) magic damage; When not active, launching an attack grants 1 Unleash. Attacking again refreshes Unleash's duration. Max Unleash is 6. If the duration is not refreshed, Yunara loses 1 Unleash every 0.5 seconds. Spirit Unbound (Active): On cast, consumes Unleash, gaining 25% / 35% / 45% / 55% Attack Speed for 5 seconds. Attacks are empowered during this time to: Deal an additional 10 / 15 / 20 / 25 (+20% AP) magic damage on-hit; Spread to enemies nearby the target, dealing them 18 (30% AD) physical damage. Transcendent State: This ability automatically activates until Yunara exits the state. If the attack Critically Strikes, its spread damage will also Critically Strike. Damage from spread attacks is increased to 250% against minions below 30% Health.

Arc of Judgment: Lets rip a spinning prayer bead in the target location, briefly granting vision of the area it travels through. The prayer bead slows enemies hit by 99%, lingering as it travels and resetting its remaining duration. When it reaches its endpoint, it lingers and expands for 1 second, regardless of whether it has hit an enemy. The initial hit deals 60 / 110 / 160 / 210 (+85% bonus AD +50% AP) magic damage and slows by 99%, decaying over 1.5 seconds; When lingering, the bead deals an additional 8 / 14 / 20 / 26 (+12% bonus AD +7.5% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies every 0.25 seconds. While Yunara is in a Transcendent State, this ability is upgraded to Arc of Ruin. Arc of Ruin: Fires a laser in the target direction that deals 160 (+120% bonus AD +75% AP) magic damage and slows by 99%, decaying over 1.5 seconds. Arc of Judgment deals 50% - 100% damage to minions and executes low-Health minions.

name.en: ARC OF JUDGMENT | ARC OF RUIN

description.en: Kanmei's Steps: Gains 30% / 35% / 40% / 45% Movement Speed for 1.5 seconds, increased to 45% / 52.5% / 60% / 67.5% when moving toward a visible enemy champion nearby. While Yunara is in a Transcendent State, this ability is upgraded to Untouchable Shadow. Untouchable Shadow: Dashes in the target direction.
Critical Strikes deal an additional 8% (per 100 AP) magic damage.

Channels for 3.5 seconds, launching 7 magical waves: While Attached, hold and drag the ability button to steer the waves. Against enemies (per wave): Deals 80 / 100 / 120 (+15% AP) magic damage. Slows by 10% for 1.25 seconds, increased by 10% per wave hit. On allied champions (per wave): Restores 20 / 35 / 50 (+5% AP) Health. Excess healing is converted into a shield instead. Best Friend Bonus: For her Best Friend, the heal is increased to 26 / 39 / 52 (+8% AP) Health. Wave Damage Stacks: Waves after the first deal 20 / 30 / 40 (+5% AP) magic damage. Yuumi can move and cast You and Me! and Zoomies while channeling.

Missile Summon: Hold and drag the ability button to steer the missile. Base Effect: Deals 60 / 100 / 140 / 180 / 220 (+20% AP) magic damage. Attached Bonus: If the missile takes at least 1 second to get to its target, its damage increases to 100 / 160 / 220 / 280 / 340 (+35% AP) magic damage. It also slows by 45% / 50% / 55% / 60% / 65% and reveals the target for 1 second. Best Friend Bonus: The missile always slows the target hit. Hitting a champion with the missile grants the ally Yuumi is Attached to 18 / 19 / 20 / 21 / 22 (+5% AP) magic damage on-hit for 5 seconds.

Best Friend Bonus (Passive): While on her Best Friend, Yuumi gains an additional 8% / 9% / 10% / 11% (+0.02% AP) Heal and Shield Power. Attach (Active): Dashes to an allied champion and Attaches to them. While Attached, she follows her partner's movement and is untargetable except by turrets. Immobilizing effects on Yuumi place this ability on a 5 seconds cooldown.

Gains a shield that absorbs 80 / 110 / 140 / 170 (+40% AP) damage and 24% / 28% / 32% / 36% (+8% AP) Attack Speed for 3 seconds. While the shield persists, she also gains 20% Movement Speed. If Yuumi is Attached, this ability affects her ally instead.

Passive: When Yuumi's attacks and abilities strike champions, she heals herself for 67 (+25% AP) Health. If Yuumi Attaches to an allied champion within 4 seconds, they are healed for the same amount as well. (18 second cooldown) Bonds of Friendship: While Attached, Yuumi gains Friendship with her ally whenever they kill a champion or minion. The ally with the most Friendship becomes her Best Fried. Best Friend Bonus: Yuumi's abilities gain bonus effects while she is Attached to her Best Friend.

Zed becomes untargetable and dashes to a target enemy champion, applying Death Mark.
After 2.8 seconds, the mark detonates, dealing physical damage equal to 100% AD + 30% of all damage Zed dealt to the target while the mark was active.
The dash leaves a shadow in place for 6 seconds. Recasting Death Mark swaps Zed's position with the shadow's.

Zed and his shadows throw shurikens. Each shuriken deals 70 (+110% bonus AD) physical damage to the first enemy hit and 49 (+77% bonus AD) physical damage to subsequent enemies.
Deals 100% damage to monsters.

Passive: Zed gains 40 Energy whenever an ability hits the same enemy twice. Energy can only be gained once per ability cast.
Active: Zed's shadow dashes forward and remains in place for 4.5 seconds. Recasting Living Shadow swaps Zed's position with the shadow's.

Zed and his shadows spin-slash, dealing 65 (+70% bonus AD) physical damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 25% for 1.5 seconds. Additional hits on the same enemy deal 50% damage and the slow becomes 50%.
Each time Zed's own slash hits an enemy champion, Living Shadow's cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds.
Deals 100% damage to monsters.
Attacks against enemies below 50% Health deal bonus magic damage equal to 7% (based on level) of their max Health (10 second cooldown per enemy).

Discharges a nova of electricity, dealing 150 (+60% bonus AD +100% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies.
On hitting an enemy champion, gains 10% Move Speed and 30% Attack Speed (which can exceed the Attack Speed cap for 5 seconds).
While active, attacks become a rapid triple-shot burst that chains to nearby enemies, dealing an additional 30% AD physical damage. This chain damage can critically strike, dealing 50% bonus damage.
Hitting an enemy champion with an attack or ability extends this ability's duration and adds 1 stack of Overcharge for 2.5 seconds. Critical Strikes add 2 additional stacks.
Each stack of Overcharge grants 0.5% Move Speed.

Zaps a target location, dealing 70 (+80% bonus AD +30% AP) magic damage to enemies in the area and slowing them by 14%, decaying over 1.5 seconds.
Killing an enemy champion with this ability refunds 50% of its cooldown and 100% of its Mana cost.

Fires an electric pulse that deals 60 (+100% AD +50% AP) physical damage to the first enemy hit and slows them by 30% for 2 seconds.
If the pulse hits a wall, it expands from the point of impact, dealing the same damage and slow to enemies in the area. The expanded pulse always critically strikes champions and monsters, dealing 50% bonus damage.

Dashes a short distance and empowers the next 3 attacks within 6 seconds to pierce, dealing 20 (+10% bonus AD +20% AP) bonus magic damage to the first target hit and 85% damage to subsequent targets. This damage increases by up to 100% based on Critical Rate.
Hitting an enemy champion with an attack or ability reduces this ability's cooldown by 0.5 seconds. Critical Strikes reduce it by 1.5 seconds instead.
Zeri vaults over any terrain she touches, greatly extending the dash distance.

Attacks fire 6 rounds in the target direction, dealing 20/24/28/32/36 (+102%/104%/106%/108%/110% AD) physical damage to the first enemy hit.
Zeri's Attack Speed is capped at 1.5 attacks per second. 60% of Attack Speed above the cap is converted into bonus Attack Damage.
Deploys the Mega Inferno Bomb to deal 270 / 375 / 480 (+85% AP) magic damage to enemies in the blast zone.
Throws a bouncing bomb that deals 70 / 135 / 200 / 265 (+65% AP) magic damage.

Flings an explosive charge that can be detonated within 4 seconds to deal 70 / 115 / 160 / 205 (+50% AP) magic damage to enemies and knock them away. Ziggs is also knocked away without taking damage. Damages turrets and demolishes them if they are below 20% / 22.5% / 25% / 27.5% Health. The charge can be detonated while in the air.

Scatters proximity mines that deal 50 / 105 / 160 / 215 (+35% AP) magic damage on contact and slow by 35% / 40% / 45% / 50% for 2 seconds. Enemies detonating multiple mines take 40% damage from subsequent mines. Mines last 5 seconds.

Passive: all of Ziggs' abilities can deal 24% damage to turrets. Empower Bouncing Bomb to deal 17 + 3 per level (+15% AP) additional magic damage and 32% damage to turrets. Short Fuse's cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds when Ziggs casts an ability.

Places a protective time rune that lasts 5 seconds on himself or an allied champion. If the rune bearer takes lethal damage during this time, they teleport back in time and become untargetable for 3 seconds before they are revived and healed for 600 / 850 / 1100 (+200% AP) Health. If the rune bearer does not trigger the rune's revival effect, 10% of Chronoshift's cooldown will be refunded.

Tosses a Time Bomb to a target location. The bomb sticks to the first unit which comes within a small area around it. After 3 seconds, it detonates, dealing 60 / 125 / 190 / 255 (+75% AP) magic damage to the target and nearby enemies. The bomb prioritizes champions and units that are already carrying a bomb. Early detonation: Placing a second bomb on the same target detonates the first bomb, stunning enemies in the blast for 1.2 / 1.3 / 1.4 / 1.5 seconds. Charge: Stores up to 2 charges. Charge Time: 12 / 11.5 / 11 / 10.5 seconds.

Makes time flow faster for himself, applying Fleeting Time to himself and gaining a shield that absorbs 45 / 70 / 95 / 120 (+45% AP) damage. Zilean also grants Fleeting Time and an identical shield to the nearest allied champion for 3 seconds. Fleeting Time: Increases projectile speed by 60% and grants 25% / 35% / 45% / 55% (+0.06% AP) Movement Speed. While Zilean's Fleeting Time is active, his Basic Ability Haste is increased by 80%.
Creates a time-bending force field for 2.5 seconds. While within the force field, enemy champions are slowed by 20% / 25% / 30% / 35% (+5% AP) and projectiles by 80%.

Stores time as Experience at a rate of 20 / 50 / 80 XP per 5 seconds. Zilean can grant this Experience to the nearest allied champion when he has enough to complete their next level up by tapping the minion button. Doing so gives Zilean the same amount of Experience. Experience can only be imparted to allies who can level up. If Zilean takes damage or is crown controlled while imparting Experience, the process will be interrupted.
Teleports to a nearby position for 1 second, then teleports back to the original position. During this time, Zoe can use abilities and attack but cannot move.

Fires a star that deals 45 + 3 (+60% AP) – 112.5 + 7.5 (+150% AP) magic damage to the first enemy hit, increasing with distance traveled. Enemies around the target take 80% damage.
Recasting changes the star's direction.

Passive: Enemies drop a spell shard when they use a Spell or an active item. Certain minions also leave a spell shard when killed by Zoe or a nearby ally. Picking up a shard lets Zoe cast its effect once.
Passive: When Zoe casts this ability or a Spell, she gains 25% Move Speed for 2 seconds and tosses 3 missiles at the target she most recently attacked. Each missile deals 25 (+15% AP) magic damage.
Active: Casts the effect of the picked-up spell shard.
Spell shards remain on the ground for 20 seconds.
Each missile applies More Sparkles!

Dropkicks a bubble that deals 40 (+50% AP) magic damage and lingers as a trap if it hits nothing. The bubble travels further when flying over terrain.
Enemies touched by the bubble fall Asleep for 2 seconds after a short delay. Attacks or ability hits wake them up, but they take bonus true damage equal to 200% of the damage dealt, up to 40 (+50% AP).
Before falling Asleep, targets become Drowsy and are increasingly slowed (up to 15%).

After using an ability, Zoe's next attack deals an additional 9–128 (based on level) (+20% AP) magic damage.
This damage is dealt instantly and deals 50% damage to structures.

Summons the fury of nature, growing thorns that deal 150 (+50% AP) magic damage at the target location. After 2 seconds, the vines snap upward, knocking up enemies hit for 1 second.
An additional Thorn Spitter sprouts for each enemy champion, large monster, or epic monster hit.
Vines spread and burst into spines, dealing 60 (+60% AP) magic damage and sprouting 1 Thorn Spitter.
Nearby Thorn Spitters become enraged, resetting their duration and gaining 35% bonus Health and 50% Attack Speed.

Sends binding vines forward, rooting enemies hit for 1 second and dealing 60 (+40% AP) magic damage.
A Thorn Spitter sprouts when this ability first hits an enemy champion or when it ends (large monsters and epic monsters count as champions).

When Grasping Roots first hits an enemy champion, a Thorn Spitter with 30 (+22% AP) Health sprouts. If no enemy champion is hit, a Thorn Spitter sprouts when Grasping Roots ends.
Thorn Spitters automatically attack targets for 6 seconds, dealing 10 (+10% AP) magic damage.
An additional Thorn Spitter sprouts for each enemy champion, large monster, or epic monster hit by Deadly Spines or Stranglethorns.
Thorn Spitters deal 23 bonus damage to monsters (based on level).
Thorn Spitters after the first deal 50% damage to the same target.
Enemy champions' abilities deal 35% damage to Thorn Spitters.
Non-epic monsters deal 35% damage to Thorn Spitters.
